title: Operadora ou Operador de área III - Linha de Fibras
description:
⚡ O que você fará:

Suportar a produção de celulose solúvel por meio de manobras de área, sendo apoio direto aos operadores de painel. Maximizar a disponibilidade das respectivas plantas sem que haja prejuízos a Segurança e ao Meio Ambiente.

Verificar as condições de operação dos equipamentos, utilizando suas competências para executar as atividades necessárias a garantir a continuidade do processo, atuando sob orientação da necessidade de procedimentos operacionais do Operador de Painel, Assistente Técnico ou gestão.

⚡ Saiba mais sobre suas atividades:

  • Registrar os pontos de atenção e desvios ocorridos no decorrer do seu turno garantindo uma correta passagem de informações nas trocas de turno e munindo o operador de painel e os demais interessados, com todas as informações necessárias ao suporte de tomadas de decisões para o bom andamento da produção, sejam elas no âmbito da qualidade, volume, custos, segurança e meio ambiente.
  • Ser um facilitador para que sejam executadas todas as manutenções corretivas e preventivas nos equipamentos, sistemas e instalações quando necessário.
  • Inspecionar a área produtiva identificando falhas e anomalias, corrigindo as mesmas, registrando e informando aos demais responsáveis que não sejam pertinentes a sua atuação.
  • Participar ativamente de programas e contribuir para a segurança, qualidade, limpeza e organização da área, bem como a preservação do meio ambiente, realizando as atividades e cumprindo as normas e procedimentos específicos.
  • Contribuir de forma efetiva para o atingimento das metas globais da organização, nas quais estejam em seu âmbito de alcance.
  • Cumprir as metas individuais, medidas por indicadores específicos, por meio das atividades pertinentes a sua função, buscando sempre o auxílio dos profissionais de outras disciplinas de atuação, além de informar/relatar aos seus gestores as eventuais dificuldades que por ventura possam surgir para o alcance dos objetivos estabelecidos.
  • Executar as atividades conforme responsabilidades definidas nos procedimentos e instruções operacionais, de qualidade, meio ambiente e segurança.
  • Executar os procedimentos necessários de liberação para manutenção nas paradas gerais, paradas programadas e não programadas, que garantam a segurança e a integridade física de todos os envolvidos na atividade.
  • Interagir de forma contínua com as demais áreas e seus operadores, seguindo o conceito de processo único e uniforme entre todos os turnos.
  • Está sempre atualizado dos parâmetros de processo e ambientais diariamente, conforme estabelecido nos procedimentos e indicadores definidos pelo setor.
  • Zelar pela conservação de todos os ativos da área e suportar a adequada operação das máquinas e equipamentos, apoiando diretamente os Operadores de Painel conforme os padrões e procedimentos operacionais pré-estabelecidos.
  • Participar das reuniões de DSS, comitê de segurança e de equipe, além de outras que assim forem demandadas.
  • Identificar condições de potencial risco a segurança, informando-os a todos interessados que fazem uso da área, reportando-os aos seus gestores e a área de Segurança.
  • Treinar e desenvolver, se houver, os operadores de área II da área.

⚡ O que esperamos de você:

  • Curso técnico em Química ou Celulose e Papel ou Eletrônica ou Eletrotécnico ou Mecânica;
  • Experiência e conhecimentos em produção de celulose na área de Linha de Fibras;
  • Domínio do pacote office como usuário;
  • Conhecimento do SAP como usuário.

title: Analista Fiscal Pleno
description:
A primeira unidade da AMAGGI, a Sementes Maggi, foi inaugurada em 1977 na cidade de São Miguel do Iguaçu, no Paraná. Dois anos depois, em 1979, tiveram início as atividades em Mato Grosso, com a aquisição de uma fazenda no município de Itiquira. Desde então, a empresa tem ampliado suas unidades e áreas de negócios, expandindo a atuação no Brasil e no exterior. Com sede em Cuiabá (MT), é hoje a maior companhia brasileira na cadeia de grãos e fibras do país e está presente também na China, Argentina, Paraguai, Holanda, Noruega, Singapura e Suíça. Além disso, desde 1997 contribui para o desenvolvimento local e humano nas comunidades onde atua, colocando-se como parceira no desenvolvimento sustentável dessas localidades por meio da Fundação André e Lucia Maggi.

Descrição

Atribuições:

  • Realizar a apuração de IRPJ e CSLL nas modalidades: Lucro Real (trimestral e anual com estimativas); Lucro Presumido;
  • Dominar a legislação tributária brasileira, incluindo: Lei nº 9.430/1996; Instruções Normativas da RFB, como: IN 1.700/2017 e IN 2.055/2021;
  • Executar obrigações acessórias, como: ECF (Escrituração Contábil Fiscal); DCTF e DCTFWeb; PER/DCOMP;
  • Atuar com Transfer Pricing (Preços de Transferência);
  • Realizar revisão de LALUR/LACS e controle de adições e exclusões fiscais;
  • Conduzir análises de dados e prestar atendimentos relacionados à área fiscal.

Requisitos Necessários

  • Graduação completa em Contabilidade, Gestão Financeira ou áreas correlatas;
  • Vivência na área fiscal;
  • Conhecimentos em: Imposto de Renda (Lucro Real e Lucro Presumido); Power BI; Excel; Transfers;
  • Inglês desejável.

*Nossas oportunidades são abertas para todos os profissionais, sem distinção de raça, cor, gênero, idade, crença e deficiência (PCD)*

title: Analista de Serviços Cloud Júnior (Protheus)
description:

O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER:

  • Atendimento técnico aos ambientes Cloud TOTVS (TCLOUD), com foco em clientes Protheus, RM e Datasul atuando em demandas de baixa e média complexidade de infraestrutura relacionadas ao TSS e TAF.
  • Análise, triagem, classificação e reclassificação de tickets envolvendo Protheus, TSS Compartilhado, TAF segregado/full, garantindo aderência aos fluxos operacionais, filas e SLAs do Cloud TOTVS;
  • Registro completo e estruturado das solicitações no sistema de atendimento, com evidências técnicas, logs, mensagens de erro, URLs, parâmetros e histórico de ações, assegurando rastreabilidade entre Cloud, Sustentação e Produto;
  • Avaliação de incidentes relacionados a comunicação Protheus x TSS, falhas de transmissão fiscal, parametrizações de URL, indisponibilidade de serviços e dependências de infraestrutura Cloud;
  • Acompanhamento das demandas e comunicação ativa de status ao cliente, conforme padrões de atendimento TOTVS, incluindo orientação técnica inicial quando aplicável;
  • Escalonamento técnico estruturado de incidentes e problemas para os times especializados (TCLOUD, Banco de Dados, Redes, Segurança, Produto Protheus/TAF/TSS), com detalhamento que permita continuidade e agilidade na resolução;
  • Atuação orientada aos indicadores operacionais e de qualidade do Cloud TOTVS (SLA, produtividade, NPS e satisfação do cliente);
  • Identificação, registro e atuação em potenciais riscos, crises ou impactos fiscais em clientes Protheus Cloud, com acionamento da coordenação e liderança conforme os procedimentos internos do TCLOUD;
  • Apoio à padronização de processos e boas práticas de atendimento Cloud, especialmente em cenários que envolvam TSS, TAF e obrigações fiscais eletrônicas.

O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ:

  • Formação: Graduação nas áreas de Tecnologia da Informação ou afins;
  • Conhecimentos práticos em Protheus, especialmente em cenários de integração com TSS e TAF;
  • Familiaridade com processos de atendimento, gestão de incidentes, problemas e requisições, com foco em SLA e rastreabilidade;
  • Noções de obrigações fiscais eletrônicas, como NF-e, NFS-e, NFC-e, CT-e, eSocial, EFD-Reinf, e impactos operacionais associados.

title: Broadcast Specialist/Coordinator
description:
About Garena:

Established in 2009 and headquartered in Singapore , Garena is a leading online games developer and publisher with a global footprint across more than 130 markets.

Garena provides global users access to popular and engaging mobile and PC online games that it develops, curates, and localizes. It champions games as a social and entertainment platform on which its communities can engage and interact.

In addition, Garena is a leading esports organizer. It hosts esports events around the world that range from grassroots local tournaments to some of the most viewed professional esports competitions globally. The Free Fire World Series 2021 Singapore, which was watched by 5.4 million concurrent viewers at its peak, holds the record for the highest concurrent viewership of any esports match in history.

About the position:

We are looking for a Broadcast Specialist/Coordinator who will be responsible for leading the planning, execution, and optimization of all broadcast and content initiatives within Free Fire Esports. This role combines production, storytelling, and digital strategy expertise to deliver world-class esports broadcasts and high-impact content that enhance the fan experience. The Broadcast & Content Specialist/Coordinator acts as a bridge between internal teams, external vendors, influencers, and regional stakeholders to ensure creative alignment, operational excellence, and consistent brand storytelling across all tournaments and platforms.

Make sure to share your CV in English.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead the full broadcast and content pipeline for Free Fire Esports — from pre-production planning to live execution and post-event content delivery.
  • Manage relationships with broadcast vendors, studios, and creative agencies, ensuring adherence to Garena’s quality standards, deadlines, and budget.
  • Supervise on-site production during tournaments, overseeing show flow, run-down execution, and coordination between technical, talent, and content teams.
  • Drive the creative direction of tournament broadcasts, including narrative development, talent integration, segment design, and audience interaction.
  • Collaborate closely with Marketing and Social Media teams to align content distribution plans, ensuring maximum reach and engagement across all digital channels.
  • Oversee the development of post-production deliverables (recaps, highlights, interviews, documentaries, etc.), ensuring consistency in tone, pacing, and storytelling.
  • Analyze viewership and engagement data to inform future broadcast and content strategies, identifying performance trends and improvement opportunities.
  • Support marketing teams with guidelines and toolkits to ensure global consistency of broadcast quality and messaging.
  • Manage the internal review process for scripts, visual assets, and show rundowns, ensuring narrative cohesion and compliance with brand standards.
  • Stay ahead of emerging broadcast technologies, formats, and fan engagement tools to continuously evolve Free Fire Esports’ viewing experience.

Main job requirements:

  • Education: Completed higher education. Desirable in Communication, Broadcasting, Media Production, or related fields.
  • Experience: 6+ years in esports broadcast production, live event coordination, or content operations.
  • Proven track record leading complex, large-scale broadcast projects with multiple stakeholders and external vendors.
  • Strong understanding of esports ecosystems, gaming audiences, and live content dynamics.
  • Experience managing creative and technical production teams (e.g., camera crew, stage talent, editors, motion designers).
  • Solid analytical skills and ability to translate viewership metrics into actionable insights.
  • Excellent project management, communication, and vendor negotiation skills.
  • Portfolio demonstrating successful execution of esports or entertainment broadcasts and digital content initiatives.
  • Fluent in English and Portuguese (written and spoken).
  • Available to work in person at our office in São Paulo, SP.
  • Preferred: Previous experience with international esports tournaments or live entertainment events. Familiarity with OBS, vMix, or other live production software, and knowledge of streaming infrastructure. Comfortable working under high-pressure live event conditions

title: Product Owner II
description:

Software / Tool Skills

This position comes with a competitive compensation and benefits package.

  • A competitive salary and performance-based bonuses.

title: Analista de RH
description:

title: Creative Copywriter
description:
About Keeta

Keeta is the international subsidiary of Meituan , a global giant in the delivery sector, and it's on an ambitious mission: to revolutionize the delivery of food and consumer goods worldwide. Our motto is simple yet powerful: “We help people eat better, live better.” Guided by this principle, we bring innovation and technology to the global stage. With over 1,000 team members around the world , Keeta is in full expansion — and you could be part of this journey!

Know more: Keeta Website

Location : 100% on site - Morumbi, SP

Please, submit your CV in English.

Portfolio Requirement: Must include campaign concepts, slogans, scripts, and cross-platform copywriting samples .

About the Role

We’re seeking a mid-level Creative Copywriter to craft compelling narratives and high-converting copy for our brand in Brazil. You’ll create promotional campaigns while ensuring brand consistency across TV, digital, and social media. A strong portfolio showcasing conceptual thinking and linguistic creativity is essential. Familiarity with advertising trends is a key differentiator.

Key Responsibilities

Copywriting & Conceptual Development

  • Write original, high-impact copy for ads (TV, digital, social), slogans, and video scripts (e.g., promos, brand films).
  • Develop campaign concepts aligned with marketing goals, from brainstorming to execution.
  • Adapt global brand messaging for the Brazilian market , ensuring cultural resonance.

Collaboration & Execution

  • Partner with designers, videomakers, and marketers to turn ideas into polished deliverables.
  • Present creative strategies and messaging recommendations to stakeholders.
  • Ensure brand voice consistency across all touchpoints (e.g., product descriptions, social posts).

Creative Problem-Solving

  • Tackle challenges with original, data-informed solutions (e.g., A/B testing copy variants).
  • Stay updated on advertising trends (e.g., TikTok hooks, influencer scripts) and apply insights.
  • Manage concurrent projects with tight deadlines (e.g., seasonal campaigns, flash sales).

Job Requirements

  • Experience as a Creative Copywriter (agency, in-house, or freelance).

Portfolio showcasing:

  • Conceptual campaigns (e.g., full-funnel copy for promos, brand storytelling).
  • Video scripts (TV commercials, digital ads) and slogans .
  • Adaptability across tones (e.g., humorous, emotional, direct response).
  • Advanced English (for localization and global collaboration).
  • Degree in Journalism, Advertising, Marketing, or Communications .

Preferred Qualifications

  • Basic understanding of visual storytelling (e.g., storyboarding, collaboration with designers).
  • Familiarity with SEO/ASO basics and performance-driven copywriting .

title: Engenheiro CAE
description:
Sobre a Empresa

A Joyson Safety Systems é uma empresa global especializada em sistemas de segurança automotiva, com foco em componentes críticos como Airbags, Cintos de Segurança, Volantes, tecnologias integradas de segurança e peças plásticas.

Estamos em busca de Engenheiro CAE para se juntar à nossa equipe. Se você deseja aprimorar sua carreira com uma empresa dinâmica e em crescimento, recomendamos que você se inscreva e faça parte da equipe JSS!

Responsabilidades da Posição:

  • Criar modelos 3D FE de componentes ou subsistemas de retenção de acordo com as especificações internas ou do cliente, utilizando ferramentas comerciais de pré-processamento de modelagem FE, como o Hypermesh.
  • Analisar a integridade estrutural ou fadiga de componentes ou subsistemas de retenção utilizando LS-DYNA, Nastran ou outros softwares comerciais.
  • Apoiar, através de CAE, o design do produto, seja conforme as especificações do cliente ou em projetos internos de desenvolvimento.
  • Documentar e comunicar os resultados das análises CAE, conclusões e recomendações de melhoria de design para a equipa de design do produto, através de apresentações e reuniões regulares.
  • Melhorar a eficiência e proficiência nas áreas especializadas necessárias para o suporte CAE do produto.
  • Ajudar a desenvolver e padronizar as melhores práticas de análise CAE.
  • Realizar correlações com os resultados de testes e otimizar o desempenho dos componentes.
  • Conduzir estudos paramétricos, DOE (Design of Experiments) ou estudos de topologia para otimização de componentes.
  • Analisar dados biomecânicos e vídeos de testes.
  • Realizar estudos paramétricos e DOE para otimização do desempenho de sistemas.
  • Analisar resultados de testes (crash/sled/OoP).
  • Manter-se atualizado sobre as regulamentações globais e os critérios de desempenho e métodos de testes de segurança ao consumidor (LatinNCAP/IIHS/C-IASI, etc.).

Requisitos da vaga:

  • Engenharia Mecânica, Automotiva ou correlatas.
  • Conhecimento em Hyperworks, LS-DYNA, PAM-Crash/Simfolder
  • Experiência com componentes automotivos.
  • Conhecimentos sólidos em mecânica, ciência dos materiais, modelagem de elementos finitos e análise.
  • Experiência em testes e análises de componentes e sistemas de retenção é desejável.
  • Experiência em análise de integridade estrutural, fadiga ou dinâmica de fluidos computacional para componentes ou sistemas mecânicos é desejável.
  • Inglês avançado mandatório, posição com reporte para o time global.

We support merchants of all sizes worldwide in achieving their growth ambitions with a comprehensive range of digital payment and financial services solutions. Ant International - Antom is the international business unit of Ant Group , the owner and operator of Alipay.

The Issuer Partnerships Manager will play a critical role in developing and managing Ant’s relationships with global issuing banks and card schemes. This role involves executing partnership strategies, driving solution enablement, monitoring performance, and building strong executive relationships with issuer and card scheme partners.

Your primary goal will be to ensure world-class, high-impact partnerships that deliver measurable results in payment performance — including success rates, dispute reduction, and optimized transaction flows.

This position will report directly to the Head of Financial Institution Partnerships (Asia & MEA) .

What You'll Do:

  • Drive Ant International-Antom’s Issuer engagement programme .
  • Manage the entire lifecycle of Issuer partnerships from strategy, enablement/implementation, and performance tracking.
  • Effectively impact Ant International-Antom customers by working with Issuer, internal product, payments ops team to deliver top-notch & optimized payment services—measurable via payment success ratio , minimized dispute/chargeback, and access to market-specific data & insights.
  • Card authorisation optimisation opportunities for merchants and investigate/resolve soft declines and other payments performance discrepancies.
  • Harness a strong executive network for building thought leadership in payments; develop and strengthen existing and prospective merchants’ and partners’ awareness of Ant International-Antom capabilities, with a focus on payment optimisation to drive business growth.

What You'll Bring:

  • 8+ years of experience working with Issuers, card schemes, and payment networks across LATAM.
  • Executive relationships with Issuers & card schemes considered a strong advantage.
  • Proven stakeholder management skills with adaptability to thrive in fast-paced environments.
  • Deep fascination with the global financial ecosystem and actionable insight into payment optimization strategies driving enterprise globalization.
  • Exceptional communicator adept at connecting with internal/external stakeholders at all organizational levels.
  • Strong product instinct to identify opportunities and leverage Ant International’s (and partners’) existing and future products strategically.
  • Advanced negotiation skills capable of managing multiple complex deals concurrently across regions.

  • Fluency in English. Experience writing English-language analytical publications.
  • Spanish speaking is a plus.
  • Positive attitude and a “can do” approach.

What We Offer:

  • Full time employment contract
  • Open and friendly working atmosphere
  • Excellent remuneration package
  • Flexible working culture and hybrid working model

How to Apply:

If you are looking for interesting and challenging job, please, do not hesitate to apply and send your CV in English.

All job applicants will be treated with strict confidentiality. Only short-listed candidates will be contacted.

About ISI Markets:

ISI Markets is the most comprehensive source of trusted data and actionable insight on emerging and developed markets. We provide the intelligence and insights to act with confidence in the world’s highest potential and fastest growing markets. ISI Markets is comprised of four brands (CEIC, EPFR, EMIS and REDD) that share a common purpose to illuminate the opportunity in emerging and developed markets where information can be hard to obtain and even harder to rely upon. We leverage deep local knowledge, well established networks and leading-edge software and advanced analytics to deliver intelligence that informs our clients’ investment, strategic and risk decisions.

Data Cloud Consultant

Recommendation:

Experience in implementing and working with strategy and data modeling, including building multiple solutions on Salesforce clouds.

- Have experience in development, strategy, business analysis, pre-sales solutions, or architecture.

Job Description:

Responsible for conducting customer discussions around requirements and technical drawing.

Development of software programs by technical specifications following programming standards and procedures, performing unit tests, performing program modifications and responding to problems by diagnosing and correcting logic and coding errors.

Ensure that secure coding and UI standards and best practices are applied during development.

Provide inputs and contribute to the improvement and maintenance of applications and programs.

Leading efforts to configure, analyze, design, develop, and maintain program code and applications.

Execution of detailed and complex unit tests and secure code testing and troubleshooting.

Conducting and supporting the source code management process.

Contributing to integration, systems and performance testing and code tuning.

Participation in secure code peer reviews.

Definition and promotion of opportunities for the reuse of code, configurations, procedures and techniques.

Requirements:

Degrees in computer science, computer engineering, or a related field are preferred.

Fluency in English to conduct technical meetings with offshore team, support teams and customers outside Brazil.

Experience with Data Architecture

Experience in writing SQL queries and data modeling, as well as governance and architecture performance practice and guidelines

Proficient in migrating data from traditional applications to Salesforce using the Import Wizard and Data Loader utility

Experienced in handling multi-country deployments and managing multiple instances of Salesforce.com

Experience with setting up and customizing managed Field Service packages is a plus.

Solution Modeling - Creates, designs, and formulates models, diagrams, and documentation using IT processes, standards, tools, version control, and build and test automation to meet business, technical, security, governance, and compliance requirements.

Data Modeling - Creates, writes, and tests data models, test scripts, and build scripts using IT processes, patterns, and tools, version control, and automation

Performance tuning - Conceptualizes, analyzes, and resolves application, database, and hardware issues using IT processes, standards, and tools, version control, and build and test automation to meet business, technical, security, governance, and compliance requirements.

Solution Validation Testing - Validates a configuration item or solution change using the IT Operating Model (ITOM), including SDLC standards, tools, and metrics, to ensure that it works as designed and meets customer requirements.

Customer Focus - Building strong customer relationships and providing customer-centric solutions.

Manages complexity – Understanding complex, high-quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to solve problems effectively.

Global perspective – Take a broad view when addressing issues, using a global lens.

Action-oriented – Taking on new opportunities and difficult challenges with a sense of urgency, high energy, and enthusiasm.

Optimizes work processes – Knowing the most effective and efficient processes to get things done, with a focus on continuous improvement.

Skills:

Knowledge of service-oriented design (SOA) principles.

Excellent oral, presentation and written communication skills.

Good interpersonal skills.

Extensive knowledge of Salesforce technology and specifically the data cloud and its features and terminologies;

Experience in positioning and implementing Salesforce Data Cloud.

Salesforce Data Cloud certifications will be a plus for this role.

Proven experience in implementation and consulting of Salesforce Data Cloud environments.

title: Technical Recruiter
description:
About Turnkey

TurnKey is the #1 Offshore Tech Staffing Firm. We expertly manage all the complexities of staffing exceptional offshore developers – covering everything from recruitment and payroll to legal compliance – so our clients can focus on what they do best: building world-class software.

The TurnKey team is growing fast and worldwide! We have employees located in Eastern European countries and Latin America (Mexico, Brazil, Colombia, Costa Rica, and Uruguay). We continue scaling remote software development teams for more than 30+ US-based enterprises and start-ups, including Headspace, R1, Sertifi, YipitData, Ironclad, BellXcel, etc. At TurnKey, we’re the ultimate matchmakers for US-based companies, creating remote dream teams.

Role Overview

We’re looking for a driven and detail-oriented Technical Recruiter to join our growing team. You will play a key role in sourcing and recruiting top tech and non-tech talent across Europe and Latin America , partnering closely with hiring managers and candidates to ensure an excellent recruitment experience from start to finish.

Key Responsibilities

  • Partner with internal teams and clients to understand hiring needs and role requirements
  • Source, screen, and engage candidates for a variety of technical and non-technical roles
  • Manage full-cycle recruitment: job posting, sourcing, screening, coordinating interviews, collecting feedback, and offer negotiation
  • Build and maintain talent pipelines for high-demand positions
  • Ensure a smooth and timely candidate experience, keeping stakeholders informed throughout the process
  • Collaborate with team members and hiring managers to continuously improve processes
  • Maintain accurate data in our applicant tracking systems and internal reports
  • Stay updated on regional hiring trends and market insights across Europe and LATAM

Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in recruiting for both technical and non-technical roles.
  • Strong knowledge of IT roles, technologies, and industry trends.
  • Familiarity with both technical and non-technical profiles
  • Solid sourcing skills and experience with LinkedIn Recruiter, job boards, and other sourcing tools
  • Strong communication and organizational skills
  • Experience hiring in Latin America
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, remote-first environment
  • Upper-Intermediate + level of English
  • Readiness to work in various time zones according to the candidates’ time zone

Why You Should Work at TurnKey:

  • We’re building a diverse team of talented individuals who bring different perspectives to the business and who feel a sense of inclusion and belonging when they join our team.
  • We welcome and celebrate new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule.
  • Provided laptop (MacBooks);
  • Opportunity to attend professional development training, certifications, and conferences. We have an Educational budget.
  • Private health insurance.
  • Free advanced English lessons with a budget of $900/year
  • Fully Remote work;
  • Free Accounting and legal support required to file taxes.
  • Team-building events in various countries across Europe, creating opportunities for the team to connect and explore together.
  • Access to a special online shop where you can use TurnKey coins to purchase exclusive branded items and fun merchandise.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Teachable is a no-code platform for creators who want to build a more impactful business through courses, coaching, downloadable content, and community. With Teachable, creators can engage their online audiences and get paid—on their own terms. Today, tens of thousands of creators use Teachable to share their knowledge and, to date, have reached more than 46 million students around the world.

Are you ready to join a dynamic, cross-cultural team at an exciting turning point in our company’s journey? Now part of the global portfolio, Teachable continues to take the creator economy by storm as a true industry leader. Together, Teachable and Hotmart are delivering market-leading products that prioritize creator control and flexibility, alongside meaningful partnership and support from our team. If you have big ideas, relish the chance to challenge convention, and deeply believe in the power of creators to shape the future, we want you on our team!

What is the role?

We are looking for a senior engineer with backend experience, who will join our team mainly focused on backend development, always focusing on delivering applications for high traffic access, well-monitored and fully tested. You will be responsible for the entire development lifecycle. In our team, everyone has the opportunity to share ideas, bring new solutions, and discuss them with other well-experienced engineers.

In this role you'll:

  • Write secure, efficient, and high-quality code that adheres to best practices, such as encryption of sensitive data and input validation.
  • Develop scalable and reusable code that promotes efficient development, such as creating reusable libraries and components.
  • Identify areas for improvement in the codebase and take ownership of small-to-medium-sized systems, such as fixing bugs and optimizing performance.
  • Quickly understand documentation and utilize testing techniques, such as unit testing, integration testing, and stress testing, to ensure high-quality code.
  • Communicate effectively with team members and stakeholders, such as providing regular status updates and actively seeking feedback.
  • Adapt to roadblocks and proactively resolve issues, such as debugging and troubleshooting.
  • Align work with customer value by using feedback to prioritize features.
  • Balance priorities and seek guidance when needed to make informed decisions.

What You’ll Bring:

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience building production web applications in an agile, startup environment.
  • Experience migrating domains from monolithic to microservices.
  • Experience working with systems at scale utilizing microservices, AWS services
  • Interest in learning or exposure to event-based architecture
  • Team player mentality: high collaborative, documentation-focused and recognizing how to balance asynchronous communications and virtual meetings
  • A passion for solving complex technical problems in both new and legacy codebases.
  • A mindset of leaving the codebase better than how you found it.
  • Experience collaborating with multiple team members with varying experience levels to design and implement technical projects.
  • Ability to work and problem-solve independently.
  • A humble, collaborative, customer-focused, and highly curious approach to problem-solving.

Nice to have:

  • Golang experience

This is a CLT contract with full benefits, paid in $BRL.

We are an equal opportunity employer, meaning we're committed to a fair and consistent interview process. title: FP&A Specialist
description:

title: Finance Manager (Brazil)
description:
The Finance Manager will oversee all financial, accounting, and tax functions for the Brazilian entity, ensuring compliance with local statutory requirements, tax regulations, and corporate reporting standards. The role encompasses daily accounting operations, month-end and year-end closings, and statutory audits, while providing management with financial analysis, budgeting support, and strategic guidance. The ideal candidate will possess strong technical accounting expertise, exceptional attention to detail, and the ability to excel in a fast-paced start-up environment.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Responsible for the maintenance of accurate financial reports and accounting records in line with corporate guidelines, corporate timelines and local statutory requirements.
  • Manage the full spectrum of the accounting functions, including accounts payables, accounts receivables, balance sheet schedules, general ledger maintenance, and cash flow management.
  • Manage closing processes and preparation of accurate and timely financial reports and analysis of financial information.
  • Ensure compliance with all federal, state, and municipal tax obligations.
  • Manage tax incentives including PPB (Processo Produtivo Básico) and tax optimization opportunities ensuring compliance with Brazilian tax laws.
  • Coordinate and liaise with external parties (e.g. banks, external auditors, tax agents, corporate secretarial agents, local tax and government authorities) to ensure smooth operations.
  • Collaborate across departments in preparing and managing the OPEX budgets.
  • Identify and implement process improvements in internal accounting and financial operations efficiency.
  • Partner with business units to provide finance-related advice.
  • Coordinate with headquarters to align local reporting with group consolidation requirements.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting.
  • Minimum 7 years of experience in finance and tax management, including 3+ years in an international setting.
  • Knowledge of Direct and Indirect tax.
  • Advanced analytical skills and high attention to detail.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to interact with all levels of the organization.
  • Ability to work independently, manage pressure, and meet tight deadlines.
  • Proficiency in English.
  • Prior experience in accounting firms is an added advantage.

title: Technical Compliance Officer (Brazil)
description:
We are a leading global fintech company providing cross-border payment solutions to enterprises worldwide, with operations across North America, Europe, the UK, Southeast Asia, and the Middle East. As we strategically expand into the Brazilian market, we are seeking a seasoned Technical Compliance Officer (Brazil) to ensure full compliance of our local operations with Brazilian financial regulations, data protection laws (LGPD), AML/KYC requirements, and payment system frameworks. This role will serve as the primary liaison with local regulators (e.g., Banco Central do Brasil, Receita Federal, ANPD), lead compliance implementation, adapt technical systems to regulatory expectations, and support routine audits, while closely collaborating with global compliance and engineering teams to embed compliance into product development.

Key Responsibilities

  • Act as the primary technical compliance liaison between the company and Brazilian regulators (including but not limited to Banco Central do Brasil, CVM, ANPD, Receita Federal);representing the engineering in regulatory engagements that involve system architecture, data flows, business contingency, audit logging, and other technical implementation aspects of compliance.
  • Participate in Brazil market-related requirements and project reviews, providing technical compliance oversight to assess requirements and ensure that products, technical architecture, and operational processes comply with Brazilian financial, payments, and data privacy regulations (such as LGPD, PIX-related rules, and BCB Resolutions), thereby enabling legally compliant business operations.;
  • Collaborate with global Compliance, Legal, Product, and Engineering teams to translate regulatory requirements into actionable technical specifications and system controls;
  • Support internal and external audits (e.g., SOX, PCI-DSS, ISO 27001) and prepare regulatory filings and compliance reports;
  • Continuously monitor regulatory developments in Brazil, assess impact on existing business and technical architecture, and propose mitigation strategies;
  • Drive the systematic and standardized documentation of technical artifacts to enhance compliance efficiency and auditability;
  • Provide compliance training and guidance to local business teams to foster a strong compliance culture.

Qualifications:

Required Qualifications

  • Language : Native-level Portuguese (written and spoken); fluent English for global collaboration;
  • Local Regulatory Knowledge : Deep understanding of Brazil’s financial regulatory landscape, including BCB payment system rules (e.g., PIX, SPB), AML/CFT regulations, and LGPD data protection requirements;
  • Technical Acumen : Familiarity with modern payment technology architectures (e.g., API-first, microservices, cloud infrastructure); ability to engage engineering teams on technical details such as data flows, encryption, and audit logging;
  • Hands-on Experience : Direct experience engaging with Brazilian regulators, submitting licensing applications, or managing on-site inspections;
  • Education : Bachelor’s degree or higher in Law, Finance, Information Technology, Risk Management, or related field.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Hold professional certifications such as CISSP, CAMS, CRCM, or similar;
  • Prior experience in fintech, payment institutions, or banking compliance roles;
  • Familiarity with international compliance standards (e.g., FATF Recommendations, GDPR, PCI-DSS) and their local implementation;
  • Experience working in multicultural teams and supporting cross-border compliance initiatives.

What We Offer

  • Opportunity to collaborate with world-class compliance and engineering experts;
  • Continuous professional development and learning resources;
  • Inclusive, diverse, and results-driven culture.

title: Senior C++ Developer
description:

This role sits at the intersection of data science, machine learning, and production-grade infrastructure , ensuring that performance-critical logic runs at optimal speed while integrating seamlessly with platforms such as Databricks, Airflow, Kubernetes, and Microsoft Azure .

Key Responsibilities

  • Optimize machine learning inference pipelines using C++-based engines (e.g., ONNX Runtime, TensorRT ) to achieve sub-millisecond latency .

  • Integrate C++ components within Kubernetes-managed microservices and Airflow workflows .
  • Collaborate closely with data scientists and ML engineers to productionize models under strict performance constraints.
  • Deploy and manage C++-based services using Terraform and Azure infrastructure.
  • Profile, benchmark, and optimize performance-critical code using tools such as perf, Valgrind, and Google Benchmark .
  • Define and contribute to platform-wide performance standards and best practices for C++ in large-scale data systems.

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering , or a related field.
  • 5+ years of professional experience in C++ development , with strong expertise in:
  • Modern C++ ( C++17 / C++20 / C++23 )
  • Performance optimization (CPU, memory, cache efficiency)
  • Low-level programming (pointers, memory layout, alignment)
  • Multithreading and concurrency (std::thread, atomics, locks)
  • Proven experience building high-throughput, low-latency systems (e.g., trading platforms, real-time analytics).
  • Hands-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes for deploying C++ services.
  • Experience integrating C++ with external systems (REST APIs, gRPC, shared libraries).
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform).
  • Exposure to data platforms such as Databricks, Spark, or Kafka (as a consumer is sufficient).

Preferred / Nice-to-Have

  • Experience with ONNX Runtime, TensorRT, or TVM for ML inference in C++.
  • Hands-on experience building C++ UDFs for Spark/Databricks (JNI or external execution).
  • Contributions to open-source C++ projects or performance-oriented libraries.
  • Background in commercial analytics, pricing, or supply chain systems .
  • Familiarity with Azure services (AKS, App Services, Azure Monitor).

Why choose us

  • An international community bringing together more than 110 different nationalities
  • An environment where trust is central: 70% of our leaders started their careers at the entry level
  • A strong training system with our internal Academy and more than 250 modules available
  • A dynamic work environment that frequently comes together for internal events (afterworks, team buildings, etc.)

Amaris Consulting promotes equal opportunities. We are committed to bringing together people from diverse backgrounds and creating an inclusive work environment. In this regard, we welcome applications from all qualified individuals, regardless of sex, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, beliefs, age, marital status, disability, or other characteristics.

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Java Developer to join our team and lead the modernization of our existing applications. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in Java development, hands-on experience with modern frameworks, and the ability to guide the migration of legacy systems to contemporary architectures.

  • Experience with Struts 2.0 or legacy frameworks and proven ability to migrate systems to modern architectures.
  • Good understanding of software design principles, OOP, design patterns , and best coding practices.
  • Experience with relational databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle, etc.).
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, Git, and DevOps concepts.

title: Desenvolvedor de Software ABAP "#987504"
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Desenvolver e manter programas ABAP (relatórios, interfaces, conversões, enhancements, formulários - RICEF) no ambiente SAP S/4HANA, seguindo as especificações funcionais e técnicas.
  • Realizar correções de bugs, otimizações de performance e ajustes em códigos ABAP existentes (código Z), aplicando as melhores práticas de desenvolvimento e garantindo a qualidade do código.
  • Analisar especificações funcionais e técnicas para propor as melhores soluções de desenvolvimento ABAP.
  • Criar e executar testes unitários e integrados para garantir a qualidade e a robustez das entregas de software.
  • Aplicar metodologias de desenvolvimento ágil e as ferramentas de gestão de código e versionamento utilizadas pelo cliente.
  • Colaborar ativamente com analistas funcionais, outros desenvolvedores e áreas de negócio para entender os requisitos e entregar soluções que agreguem valor.
  • Manter a documentação técnica dos desenvolvimentos clara, completa e atualizada.
  • Participar de revisões de código (code review) e contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos padrões de desenvolvimento da equipe.
  • Prestar suporte técnico Nível 3 para incidentes complexos que exijam análise aprofundada de código ABAP, identificando e implementando soluções eficazes.
  • Pesquisar e se manter atualizado sobre novas tecnologias e abordagens de desenvolvimento no ecossistema SAP S/4HANA (ex: ABAP on HANA, CDS Views, OData).

O que você precisa ter

  • Experiência em desenvolvimento ABAP para SAP ECC e/ou S/4HANA.
  • Experiência no desenvolvimento de objetos RICEF (Reports, Interfaces, Conversions, Enhancements, Forms).
  • Vivência em análise e depuração (debugging) de programas ABAP.
  • Sólido conhecimento da linguagem de programação ABAP e ABAP Orientado a Objetos.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de desenvolvimento ABAP (SE80, SE38, SE24, SE37, Eclipse com ADT).
  • Conhecimento em Dicionário de Dados ABAP (DDIC).
  • Experiência com técnicas de enhancement (User-Exits, Customer-Exits, BADIs, Enhancement Spots).
  • Conhecimento em desenvolvimento de relatórios (ALV Grid/Tree).
  • Familiaridade com a criação de formulários (SmartForms e/ou Adobe Forms).
  • Noções de performance tuning em ABAP.

Onde você vai trabalhar?

Acreditamos na troca de experiências e valorizamos as relações através do Regime Presencial, em Curitiba/PR.

Será um destaque seu perfil com:

  • Experiência com desenvolvimento em SAP S/4HANA (CDS Views, AMDP, OData Services, ABAP RAP).
  • Conhecimento em desenvolvimento de interfaces (IDocs, Proxies, RFCs, Web Services).
  • Experiência com SAP Fiori/UI5.
  • Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban).
  • Conhecimento em módulos funcionais SAP (ex: SD, MM, FI, CO) para melhor entendimento dos requisitos.

title: Pessoa Coordenadora de Qualidade
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Coordenar a equipe de SAC, recepção e Ambiência, visando a melhor experiência do cliente e a excelência em atendimento, tratando diretamente situações críticas de atendimento ao cliente e que necessitem de intervenção;
  • Coordenar a equipe do fraldário, proporcionando atendimento e ambientes agradáveis com excelência para aos clientes.
  • Acompanhar e analisar indicadores, bem como as pesquisas de NPS
  • Desenvolver e implementar políticas, procedimentos e diretrizes de qualidade em todas as áreas sob sua responsabilidade, incluindo, atendimento, limpeza, paisagismo, higiene alimentar, dedetização, gestão de resíduos e reciclagem, obras em lojas e reformas internas;
  • Gerenciar as atividades de equipes terceirizadas que prestam serviços essenciais para o shopping, como limpeza, HSA, asseio, paisagismo, gestão de resíduos, reciclagem, aromatização.
  • Garantir que os restaurantes e as operações de alimentação do shopping sigam rigorosamente os padrões de higiene alimentar da Anvisa, com o controle e gestão da consultoria terceira, que realiza um ciclo de inspeções e ações corretivas, notificando as lojas inadequadas quando necessário.
  • Manter e aperfeiçoar o padrão de reciclagem e boas práticas sustentáveis que o Shopping realiza, com o intuito de ampliar e estender o programa, a fim de desenvolver e implantar melhores práticas para minimizar o impacto ambiental do shopping e atingir e mata da companhia.
  • Coordenar projetos de reforma de ambientes internos do Shopping e supervisionar obras contratadas pela ALLOS. Gerenciar as Obras e reformas de lojas no shopping, garantindo que as obras sejam executadas de acordo com os padrões de qualidade estabelecidos e ocorram dentro do prazo programado.
  • Gerenciar e orientar equipe orgânica, garantindo que todos cumpram suas responsabilidades de forma eficaz.
  • Preparar relatórios de desempenho de qualidade e comunicar regularmente os resultados e problemas ao Gerente de Operações.

Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Superior completo em Arquitetura, hotelaria ou turismo;
  • Experiência em gestão de pessoas;
  • Domínio dos softwares AutoCAD e SketchUp;
  • Pacote Office avançado;
  • Experiência prévia em funções relacionadas à gestão da qualidade e atendimento em shopping centers ou em setores similares;
  • Conhecimento de regulamentações e normas de segurança e qualidade.

title: Workday Recruiting and Talent Analyst
description:
Já pensou em trabalhar em uma empresa líder global em dados, insights, consultoria e que contribui para o sucesso e crescimento das principais organizações do mundo?

Então essa é a sua chance!

Buscamos: Workday Recruiting and Talent Analyst

About the Role

As a key member of our Workday Application Management Support team, the Workday Recruiting and Talent Analyst will own the configuration, maintenance, and support of our Recruiting, Talent, Performance and Learning modules.

You will partner closely with HR and Talent Acquisition Teams to ensure Workday solutions align with evolving business needs, legal / regulatory requirements, and employee experience goals.

This role requires deep functional expertise in Workday configuration, strong problem-solving skills, and the ability to translate HR and Recruiting requirements into scalable Workday solutions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Maximize the effectiveness of Workday by configuring, maintaining, and continuously optimizing Workday Recruiting, Talent, Performance, and Learning modules.
  • Enable better talent decisions and development by supporting scalable, user-friendly solutions for career growth, goal tracking, and feedback collection.
  • Enhance the candidate and employee experience by resolving issues and queries that impact usability, accuracy, or workflow across recruiting and talent modules.
  • Drive the success of the annual performance review cycle by owning the configuration, launch, monitoring, and post-cycle review of performance processes, while identifying opportunities for process and system improvements.
  • Ensure data accuracy and process scalability by preparing, loading, and validating EIBs for mass data updates.
  • Maximize system performance and adoption by evaluating new Workday releases, identifying relevant enhancements, and recommending high-impact improvements to stakeholders.
  • Ensure system reliability and business continuity by proactively monitoring health and resolving issues across Recruiting and Talent modules.
  • Improve transparency and knowledge sharing by maintaining clear, user-friendly documentation for configurations, business processes, and system policies.
  • Accelerate continuous improvement initiatives through cross-functional collaboration with analysts, IT teams, HR, Talent Acquisition and business stakeholders, delivering enhancements that add value and reduce manual effort.
  • Safeguard data integrity and compliance by ensuring configurations align with internal governance, audit requirements, and security standards.
  • Enhance user confidence and self-service adoption by contributing to the development of end-user training materials in partnership with HR.

Qualifications

Required:

  • 4+ years of hands-on Workday configuration experience, with expertise in Recruiting, Talent, Performance and Learning modules.
  • Strong understanding of HR and Recruiting policies.

title: Scrum Master
description:
Senior Scrum Master - Customer Data Ecosystem

Brazil

Contract-to-hire

Job Description

You were made to do this work: designing new technologies, diving into data, optimizing digital experiences, and constantly developing better, faster ways to get results. You want to be part of a performance culture dedicated to building technology for a purpose that matters. Here, you’ll work in an environment that promotes sustainability, inclusion, wellbeing, and career development while you help us deliver better care for billions of people around the world. It starts with YOU.

In this role, you will:

  • Facilitate daily stand-ups, sprint planning, sprint reviews, and retrospectives for the customer data ecosystem teams
  • Remove obstacles and impediments that hinder the team’s progress, ensuring smooth and efficient workflows.
  • Coach the team on Agile principles and practices, ensuring adherence to Scrum frameworks.
  • Collaborate with product owners to manage the product backlog and ensure clear communication of requirements.
  • Track team performance metrics, such as velocity and burndown, and work to improve productivity and efficiency.
  • Promote a culture of continuous improvement within the team, encouraging the adoption of Agile best practices.
  • Foster a collaborative environment where team members feel empowered to contribute and innovate.
  • Work with legal and compliance teams to ensure that all sprints consider data privacy and regulatory requirements.
  • Facilitate the integration of compliance requirements into the agile development process.
  • Lead efforts to align Scrum practices with the organization’s digital marketing strategy and goals.
  • Provide guidance on managing dependencies between teams and coordinating cross-team collaboration.
  • Stay current with industry trends in Agile methodologies, applying relevant advancements to improve team performance.
  • Ensure that the team’s work is aligned with business objectives, delivering value to the organization.
  • Provide training and mentoring to team members and other Scrum Masters within the organization.
  • Lead efforts to resolve conflicts and challenges within the team, ensuring a positive and productive work environment.
  • Drive Change Management through coaching the team and support them on the Transformation journey by establishing clear processes and challenging them on shifting mindset
  • Oversee the integration and use of Azure Dev Ops tools within project teams to optimize collaboration, code management, and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Drive the adoption of Azure DevOps features among the team, ensuring they are leveraged to enhance project transparency and delivery efficiency

description:
Somos a Seguros Unimed , a Seguradora do Sistema Unimed, uma empresa criada por médicos e que tem o cooperativismo na essência. Cuidamos das instituições e das pessoas, para que possam viver bem o presente e planejar o futuro com segurança. Acreditamos que a cooperação nos conecta para crescermos juntos.

Pelo 7º ano consecutivo , a Seguros Unimed integra o ranking dos Lugares Mais Incríveis para Trabalhar 2025, da FIA e do Estadão. E este ano, alcançamos o patamar MÁXIMO: somos O MAIS INCRÍVEL!

Venha fazer parte da Seguros Unimed e ter uma Jornada Incrível conosco!

  • Garantia Funeral;

  • Foco nos produtos saúde e odonto.

** VAGA TEMPORÁRIA - 7 MESES - COM POSSIBILIDADE DE EFETIVAÇÃO **

title: Especialista Fiscal (ERP)
description:
Nós da Odoo acreditamos que softwares para gerenciar negócios devem cobrir necessidades complexas sem serem complicados. Somos um conjunto de aplicativos de negócios em código aberto que cobre todas as necessidades das pequenas e médias empresas: CRM, e-commerce, contabilidade, estoque… Ajudamos empresas a se tornarem mais eficientes, gastando menos!

Aqui na Odoo, Especialistas Fiscais são pessoas colaborativas, orientadas para resultados, com visão analítica e paixão por tecnologia. São responsáveis por garantir o sucesso da Localização Brasileira no nosso software, implementando seus módulos e atuando em contato direto com os clientes para assegurar a conformidade com as legislações fiscais e tributárias.

Para isso, você será a linha de frente, analisando as necessidades dos clientes, projetando a solução, configurando os fluxos fiscais, e fornecendo sessões de treinamento . Sua atuação é crucial para garantir que os projetos sejam entregues dentro do prazo e do orçamento, além de ser um ponto importante de apoio para o time de P.O. de Localização Brasileira.

Também será responsável por manter atualizada a nossa base de conhecimento dos fluxos de localização brasileira, facilitando a autonomia do cliente após a implementação.

Basicamente, você será responsável por fornecer a melhor solução de gerenciamento fiscal/contábil aos seus clientes, prestando suporte interno com as demandas fiscais e tributárias necessárias para facilitar os negócios dos nossos clientes, apoiando PMEs de diversos setores a extrair o máximo valor da Odoo. Atuamos com foco no usuário, de maneira ágil, dinâmica e sempre pensando no longo prazo.

Responsabilidades e dia a dia:

  • Gerenciar o relacionamento com os clientes durante a implementação do Odoo.
  • Analisar as necessidades do cliente e os requisitos fiscais e contábeis.
  • Prestar apoio para time interno de Analistas de Negócios e Time Comercial com dúvidas e validações contábeis/fiscais.
  • Garantir que os projetos estão em conformidade com as fundamentações fiscais corretas através da operacionalização no Portal Avalara (será treinado).
  • Atuará com implementação de projetos compreendendo a nova reforma tributária a partir de 2026.
  • Documentar os cenários de validação fiscal dos projetos, gerar relatórios e documentações dos fluxos fiscais para documentação interna e documentação de cliente.
  • Atuar diretamente em contato com o P.O. do produto de Localização Brasileira para apoiar em especificações técnicas e testes de funcionalidades e bugfixes.

O que esperamos de você:

title: PLM Engineer III
description:
PLM Engineer III @ Remote

Job Summary:

In this role, the PLM Engineer III will serve as a technical expert in the areas of infrastructure related to manufacturing information systems. The engineer will identify methods and architect solutions to provide a high level of service to end-users of the application(s). This role will help build out, maintain, and troubleshoot a rapidly expanding application system and its infrastructure. The Engineer will work closely with other engineers, analysts, and leadership to obtain regular feedback on design and execution. Additionally, the Engineer will provide periodic operational support and maintenance of the manufacturing systems.

Essential Duties:

• Responsible for the maintenance, optimization, troubleshooting, upgrades, installation and documentation of infrastructure related to Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) systems which

includes PLM database management, project management systems, CAD and PDM systems,

• Administration of new and existing technologies, including the design, documentation, install, configuration, maintenance, integration, and testing related systems

• Leads collaboratively with business customers on hardware, middleware, and application requirements.

• Leads with vendors, engineers, analysts, and leadership to ensure the integrity of databases, application software and data

• Performs regular system monitoring, verifying the integrity, health and availability of all systems and key processes, reviewing application and system logs, and ensuring completion of scheduled jobs

• Leads problem-solving efforts regarding system and service matters and if necessary, facilitates support with outside personnel, organizations, and/or vendors

• Monitor tech-industry trends, and brings new ideas and innovative solutions

• Develop new deliverables as needed based on operational requirements and following best practices for documentation and delivery

• Analyzes data to drive decision making and recommendations.

• Configure and deploy devices and peripherals as necessary

• Resolves issues, problems and questions on-site assigned from a ticketing system

Qualifications: Requirements - Required and/or Preferred

Education:

• Basic: Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, or similar discipline, and/or equivalent related work experience

• Preferred: PLM Certification

Essential Qualifications:

• Hands-on experience with ARAS (PLM tool) and SolidWorks (CAD system)

• Minimum of 4+ years of hands-on experience in a factory or enterprise setting

• Minimum of 2+ years of hands-on experience with PLM

• Technical expertise with PLM systems such as CAD, PDM, ERP, PMO

• Excellent communication (oral and written) skills, including the ability to explain and present technical information

• Effectively train and advise users on information technology issues

• Prepare written documentation in a clear and concise style

• Demonstrated ability to work in a fast-paced, flexible environment and take the initiative to learn new tools and concepts quickly

• Creative thinker with attention to detail, strong analytical, multitasking, and interpersonal skills

• Approachable and adaptable

• Ability to work extended-hours or outside of normal business hours including weekends as needed

• Skills in MS Office (Word, Power Point, Excel, Outlook)

• Must have working-level knowledge of the English language, including reading, writing, and speaking English

Preferred Qualifications:

• Prior experience in a factory environment desirable

• Technical experience with database management & language (SQL, Oracle)

• Able to work independently and in a team environment, as well as with cross-functional groups

• Resilient, self-motived and able to work well under pressure

title: Data Tech Lead
description:
A Netz está estruturando e evoluindo sua plataforma de dados e iniciativas de IA. Procuramos um(a) profissional para liderar tecnicamente a estratégia e a execução, com foco em arquitetura, padrões de engenharia, confiabilidade e segurança, atuando perto do negócio (mercado financeiro).

Responsabilidades:

  • Liderar a arquitetura e o roadmap da plataforma de dados (ingestão, transformação, consumo e governança).
  • Construir e manter pipelines  batch e streaming , com qualidade, observabilidade e SLAs.
  • Projetar e operar  arquiteturas event-driven : publicação/consumo, contratos de eventos, reprocessamento e idempotência.
  • Definir padrões de modelagem para  OLTP (transacional) e  analítico , garantindo performance e escalabilidade.
  • Projetar e operar soluções com  bancos relacionais, não relacionais e vetoriais (busca semântica, RAG, embeddings).
  • Integrar e padronizar serviços em  Azure (principal) e, como diferencial, atuar com  AWS quando fizer sentido.
  • Evoluir práticas de engenharia (CI/CD, testes, IaC, code review, SRE/observabilidade).
  • Mentorar e desenvolver o time, elevando barra técnica e velocidade de entrega.
  • Fazer interface com stakeholders para transformar requisitos do negócio em soluções bem definidas e sustentáveis.

Requisitos (essenciais)

  • Experiência liderando iniciativas de engenharia de dados/plataforma como referência técnica (tech lead/staff).
  • Python forte e experiência com  Django (APIs, serviços, integrações, boas práticas).
  • Domínio de  dados relacionais e transacionais : SQL avançado, modelagem, tuning, índices/particionamento.
  • Experiência com  dados não relacionais (documento/chave-valor/colunar) e trade-offs.
  • Experiência prática com  bancos vetoriais e search semântica (embeddings, chunking, retrieval, reranking, avaliação).
  • Experiência com  streaming e mensageria, incluindo:
  • Kafka (tópicos, particionamento, consumer groups, offset, rebalancing),
  • padrões como  exactly-once/at-least-once , DLQ, retries, ordering,
  • schema evolution e contratos (ex.:  Avro/Protobuf + Schema Registry ).
  • Experiência em  Azure (storage/compute/rede/segurança/observabilidade) e boas práticas de cloud.
  • Prática com Git, CI/CD e padrões de qualidade de código.

Ferramentas e tecnologias (esperado ou desejável)

  • Streaming/Mensageria: Kafka, Confluent, Kafka Connect, Debezium (CDC), Azure Event Hubs/Service Bus.
  • Processamento: Spark/Databricks, Flink (desejável), jobs em Python, microserviços.
  • Orquestração: Airflow, Prefect, Dagster (ou equivalente).
  • Storage/Lake: ADLS/S3 (diferencial), parquet/delta/iceberg (conforme cenário).
  • Observabilidade: logs, métricas e traces (OpenTelemetry), dashboards e alertas.
  • Infra/DevOps: Docker, Kubernetes (AKS), Terraform/Bicep (ou equivalente), gestão de segredos.
  • IA/LLMOps (diferencial): RAG, avaliação, monitoramento, guardrails, feature store.

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência no  mercado financeiro (crédito, risco, fundos, regulatório, LGPD/compliance).
  • Atuação em  projetos de IA (RAG, LLMOps, avaliação, monitoramento).
  • Experiência com  AWS (mesmo que menor) para cenários específicos (interoperabilidade/migração/serviços gerenciados).
  • Experiência com  CDC e integração de sistemas transacionais com analítico (Debezium/Kafka Connect).

Local e formato

  • Berrini - São Paulo.
  • Modalidade: Presencial;

Você atuará na operação, automação e suporte contínuo dessas plataformas, atuando como ponte entre operações e governança de dados, com foco em estabilidade, segurança e eficiência de custos . Este não é um papel tradicional de DevOps para aplicações — buscamos alguém com entendimento do ecossistema de dados no Azure e capacidade para criar soluções escaláveis e resilientes.

Requisitos Técnicos

  • Experiência com administração de ambientes Azure , especialmente em serviços de dados (SQL, Synapse, Data Factory, Databricks).
  • Conhecimento em Unity Catalog e governança de dados em ambientes Databricks.
  • Habilidade com ferramentas de monitoramento: Azure Monitor, DataDog, Log Analytics .
  • Experiência em automação com Terraform e Python .
  • Familiaridade com Git, GitHub Actions e Airflow para pipelines de dados e CI/CD.
  • Vivência com gestão de custos em nuvem (Azure Cost Management) e boas práticas de FinOps.
  • Conhecimento em RBAC, políticas de segurança e compliance em ambientes cloud.
  • Boa comunicação em inglês.

Envie seu currículo atualizado com destaque para experiências em Azure, plataformas de dados e automação .

Se você é apaixonado por tecnologia, dados e quer impactar positivamente a operação de plataformas críticas, vamos conversar!

title: PMO Analyst - Telecommunications
description:

  • MBA or equivalent degree in Project Management.

title: Auxiliar de cozinha
description:
FRATELLI RESTAURANTE E PIZZARIA está em busca de um(a) AUXILIAR DE COZINHA com vivência em A LA CARTE que queira construir uma história conosco. Se você quer crescer em um lugar onde qualidade e valorização andam juntas, essa é a oportunidade para você!

O QUE O AUXILIAR DE COZINHA FARÁ POR AQUI

Organizar o mise en place, faz o pré-preparo (picar, lavar, porcionar), auxilia no cozimento, cuida da limpeza e higiene, organiza estoque e utensílios, e ajuda na finalização e entrega dos pratos, sendo um suporte essencial para o Chef e cozinheiros. Especificamente:

MISE EN PLACE: Organizar bancadas, utensílios e ingredientes antes do serviço.

PRÉ-PREPARO: Lavar, cortar, picar, ralar e porcionar legumes, carnes, empanar e outros ingredientes.

SUPORTE AO COZINHEIRO: Ajudar no preparo e cozimento básico dos pratos conforme orientação.

HIGIENE E LIMPEZA: Manter a cozinha, equipamentos (panelas, facas) e utensílios limpos, além de cuidar do descarte correto de resíduos.

ORGANIZAÇÃO DO ESTOQUE: Verificar validades, organizar despensa e geladeiras, e informar reposição.

FINALIZAÇÃO: Ajudar na montagem e entrega dos pratos finalizados aos garçons.

O QUE BUSCAMOS EM SEU PERFIL?

- Vivência prática com as operações de restaurante;

- Atendimento cortês e eficiente;

- Facilidade em lidar com pessoas;

- Dinamismo para realizar as atividades.

- 1% de bônus sobre metas batidas;

- Sem desconto na folha do INSS;

- Plano de carreira;

Domingo à Sexta-feira: 15:30 às 00h. 

Sábado: 15:30 às 01h

Fixa na semana

title: Leader-Merchant Informatization
description:
About Us

Keeta, the international subsidiary of Meituan—the global delivery giant—is on a mission to transform food and consumer product delivery worldwide. With our core belief: "We help people eat better, live better," we're taking innovation to the global stage.

In less than one year, Keeta became an industry leader in Hong Kong, China. Soon after, we expanded into Saudi Arabia and are now present in more than 20 cities. Following our recent successful launch in Qatar, Kuwait and the UAE, we're bringing that same speed and innovation to more of the Middle East, and to Brazil.

Job Responsibilities

  1. Team Management and Deliverables: Responsible for managing a local Keeta team of approximately 30-40 people in Brazil, responsible for uploading and verifying all merchant information, ensuring data efficiency, completeness, and accuracy. This requires balancing limited resources and delivering high-quality team results on time.
  2. Mechanism and Process Development: Establish comprehensive internal and external collaboration workflows and oversight mechanisms, continuously optimizing processes to ensure the team accurately and efficiently serves business needs.
  3. Core Metric Monitoring: Monitor and report key onboarding metrics, proactively identify and resolve issues to ensure a smooth onboarding experience for merchants.
  4. Team Collaboration: Work closely with sales, compliance, and product teams to streamline the onboarding process and meet merchant needs.
  5. Team Development and Capacity Building: Develop training materials and conduct onboarding training for new employees and merchants as needed.

Job Requirements

  1. Highly responsible and unwaveringly committed to achieving goals and results.
  2. Effective in resource management and problem-solving.
  3. A strong learner, eager to continuously acquire new skills and adapt to a constantly changing business environment.
  4. A proactive team player who supports colleagues and enhances team efficiency through excellent communication skills.
  5. Native Portuguese speaker, fluent in English (listening, speaking, reading, and writing).
  6. Experience in merchant operations support is preferred.

Why Join Keeta

Keeta is redefining the future of food delivery with a bold vision and innovative spirit. As a fast-scaling brand under Meituan's global ambition, we offer a unique blend of stability and startup energy, providing boundless opportunities for personal and professional growth. Whether you want to specialize in your field or gain cross-functional experience, Keeta empowers you to take charge of your career.

As we expand globally, we are committed to building a workplace that reflects our unique culture while incorporating global best practices. You'll be part of a company that's transforming the delivery industry while supporting local communities, empowering merchants, and delivering outstanding customer experiences.

At Keeta, you'll collaborate with a passionate and pragmatic global team across over 57 countries, bringing diverse perspectives that drive creativity and innovation. We believe diversity is our strength and it pushes us to deliver better solutions for our customers and partners in Hong Kong, Saudi Arabia, and beyond.

Keeta offers limitless career growth and equal development opportunities, empowering you to grow as the company grows. Every day presents an opportunity for you to make a meaningful impact, grow professionally, and be part of something extraordinary. You'll thrive in a dynamic environment where every contribution is valued. Together, let's build the future of food delivery.

Sobre a Agropalma

A Agropalma é uma empresa brasileira reconhecida em todo o mundo como referência na produção sustentável de soluções com óleo de palma. Sua trajetória começou em 1982, no município de Tailândia (PA), e sua atuação perfaz toda a cadeia produtiva – da fabricação de mudas ao óleo refinado e gorduras especiais às soluções de alto valor agregado, incluindo produtos orgânicos. Atualmente, a companhia conta com seis indústrias de extração de óleo bruto, duas refinarias e um terminal de exportação alfandegado, e emprega cerca de 5 mil colaboradores. A Agropalma também foi pioneira em implementar, há mais de 20 anos, um programa de Agricultura Familiar com palma, que beneficia hoje mais de 300 agricultores parceiros. Guiada pelo compromisso com o planeta e as pessoas, a empresa segue avançando em suas práticas para tornar a palma sustentável uma referência brasileira. Para mais informações, acesse: .

title: Prestador(a) de Serviços em Desenvolvimento de Software (PJ - Nível Inicial)
description:

Título: Prestador(a) de Serviços em Desenvolvimento de Software (PJ – Nível Inicial)

Descrição da Empresa

AdvSpace é o último software jurídico que um escritório jurídico brasileiro utilizará em sua existência.

Com o uso por dezenas de escritórios ao redor do Brasil, o AdvSpace integra gestão, atendimento e automação com Inteligência Artificial, aumentando a produtividade em escala.

Produzir soluções em forma de software para o AdvSpace, atuando na evolução contínua do produto, seja na melhoria de funcionalidades existentes, seja na construção de novas soluções, com foco em qualidade técnica, prazos e alinhamento com os objetivos do sistema.

  • Desenvolver código para o AdvSpace conforme processos e padrões de qualidade acordados.
  • Participar de reuniões de alinhamento técnico e de planejamento, quando previamente agendadas.

Competências Técnicas (Hard Skills)

  • Algoritmo e Programação.

  • HTML 5.
  • React.
  • Python.
  • Typescript.
  • Serverless.

  • RESTful API.

Competências Comportamentais (Soft Skills)

  • Transparência.
  • Comprometimento.
  • Comunicação.
  • Pensamento crítico.
  • Idoneidade.
  • Autocontrole.

Formação e Experiência

Formação mínima: Estudante de Graduação em Ciência da Computação ou áreas correlatas.

Experiência desejável: Não é necessária experiência profissional prévia; experiência em projetos acadêmicos ou pessoais será considerada.

Certificações / cursos complementares: Certificações e cursos relacionados às tecnologias e competências indicadas na vaga serão considerados diferenciais.

Indicadores de Resultado

  • Cumprimento de prazos de entrega.
  • Qualidade técnica das entregas (baixa taxa de retrabalho).

Relacionamentos externos: Parceiros de integração do AdvSpace, quando houver necessidade técnica de alinhamento.

Profissional planejador e/ou analítico, com interesse genuíno em atuar em produto digital, capacidade de resolver problemas de forma estruturada, abertura a feedbacks e disposição para aprender continuamente.

Organização do trabalho:
