title: Data Visualization Specialist
description:
About the Product:

For more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections.

Role Summary:

We are looking for a technical builder to own our data visualization layer. You will develop custom, interactive data products for our customers using Shiny for Python and maintain rapid internal reporting using Looker Studio.

Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Data Visualization Product Development (Shiny for Python)
  • Architect, build, and deploy production-grade, highly-interactive data applications for customer-facing delivery using the Shiny for Python framework.
  • Lead the full development lifecycle, encompassing the design of intuitive user interfaces (UI) and the implementation of robust, performant server-side logic and reactivity.
  • Implement best practices for code quality, testing, modularization (e.g., Shiny modules), and deployment on platforms like Posit Connect to ensure a reliable and scalable data product experience.
  • Business Intelligence and Internal Reporting Management
  • Serve as the owner and subject matter expert for the internal Business Intelligence environment, primarily utilizing Looker Studio.
  • Design, develop, and maintain automated dashboards and reports that deliver timely and actionable insights to internal stakeholders, effectively replacing manual reporting processes.
  • Apply advanced BI techniques, including the creation of complex calculated fields and data blending, to integrate diverse datasets for a unified view of performance.
  • Data Querying and Performance Optimization
  • Develop, optimize, and maintain efficient, production-ready SQL queries, leveraging advanced techniques such as Common Table Expressions (CTEs) and window functions.
  • Actively manage the performance layer of data visualization products, ensuring both Shiny applications and Looker Studio reports execute quickly and maintain responsiveness under anticipated data volumes and user load.
  • Collaborate closely with Data Engineering teams to understand and leverage the underlying data warehouse structure (e.g., Python, SQL).
  • User Experience (UX) and Data Design
  • Translate complex, multi-dimensional datasets into clean, visually compelling, and intuitive user experiences, moving beyond simple table and chart outputs to sophisticated data narratives.
  • Champion a high-end aesthetic in all data products, focusing on design principles that enhance data comprehension and drive user adoption.

Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:

  • Aesthetic and Design Acumen: Ability to translate complex analytical findings into beautiful, polished, and intuitive visualizations, evidenced by a strong public portfolio.
  • Technical Agility: Proficiency in the core Tech Stack, including Python, SQL, Posit Connect, Looker Studio, and Git.
  • Self-Direction and Initiative: Proven ability to manage a visualization portfolio autonomously, proactively identify and implement improvements, and take ownership of the data visualization layer.
  • Problem-Solving: Dexterity to effectively deal with technical ambiguities and continuously seek process improvements in data product delivery.
  • Communication: Strong interpersonal and communication skills to effectively gather requirements from non-technical stakeholders and present complex data concepts clearly.

Requirements:

  • Advanced Proficiency in Shiny for Python: Deep expertise in developing, deploying, and managing production-grade Shiny applications, including a solid understanding of reactivity principles, modular design, and front-end styling.
  • Expert BI Tool Experience: Strong, hands-on experience with Looker Studio, particularly in data blending, custom calculations, and connecting to various data sources.
  • Advanced SQL Skills: Demonstrated ability to write complex, performant SQL queries (using CTEs, window functions, and advanced joins) for data manipulation and preparation prior to visualization.

Nice-to-haves:

  • Familiarity with other data visualization libraries in Python (e.g., Plotly, Dash) to complement Shiny.
  • Experience with other BI platforms (e.g., Tableau, Power BI) is a plus.
  • Experience in the higher education or SaaS technology sectors.

Credentials and Experience:

  • College degree or equivalent professional life/work experience in a quantitative or technical field.
  • 3+ years of dedicated, hands-on experience in a role focused on data visualization development, BI reporting, or data product creation, preferably within a fast-paced technology or SaaS environment.

We offer:

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health/Sport Budget.
  • Fully remote.

title: Data Scientist
description:
DYWIDAG stands as a global leader in construction and infrastructure technology that works with government authorities, asset owners, construction companies, and design offices to support their infrastructure projects. We have expanded into over 50 countries worldwide and continue to keep infrastructure safe and secure every single day.

Purpose of the Job

We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Data Scientist to join our team. The ideal candidate will have 2–3 years of hands-on experience as a data scientist in a business environment, supporting multiple departments and functions with predictive analytics and rapid development of minimal viable products (MVPs). A strong emphasis is placed on experience with pricing engines and sales forecasting solutions. You will be responsible for analyzing large datasets, building predictive models, and enabling data-driven decision-making across the organization.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Collect, clean, and preprocess structured and unstructured data from diverse sources.
  • Develop, implement, and optimize statistical models, machine learning algorithms, and data mining techniques.
  • Rapidly prototype and deliver MVPs to address business needs, especially in pricing and sales forecasting.
  • Collaborate with the Global BI Team and cross-functional stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into actionable analytical solutions.
  • Support various departments (e.g., Sales, Finance, Operations) with tailored predictive models and insights.
  • Visualize data insights using dashboards and reports, primarily with Power BI.
  • Clearly communicate findings and recommendations to stakeholders through presentations and documentation.
  • Continuously improve data quality, analytical processes, and model performance.
  • Stay current with the latest trends and technologies in data science, machine learning, and AI.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related field.
  • 2–3 years of proven experience as a data scientist in a business setting, supporting multiple departments/functions.
  • Demonstrated expertise in developing predictive models for pricing engines and sales forecasting.
  • Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, R, or SQL.
  • Experience with data visualization tools, especially Power BI.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Azure cloud platforms is preferred.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration abilities.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with big data technologies (e.g., Azure Data Factory, Synapse, Spark, Hadoop).
  • Knowledge of deep learning frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch).
  • Industry experience in Construction is preferred; experience in Manufacturing or Engineering-related Big Data is also relevant.

title: Operador(a) Painel de Gaseificação
description:
O Projeto Sucuriú marca a entrada da divisão de celulose da Arauco no Brasil. O investimento de US$4.6 bilhões inclui a construção de uma planta com capacidade de produção de 3,5 milhões de toneladas de fibra curta de celulose/ano. Está localizado em uma área de 3.500 hectares, a 50 quilômetros do centro da cidade de Inocência (MS) e ao lado do Rio Sucuriú. A etapa de terraplanagem começou em 2024 e a previsão de entrada em operação é no final de 2027. Em todas as fases desenvolvimento do Projeto, e de maneira contínua, monitora e respeita a biodiversidade local, identificando espécies de flora e fauna nativas da região, além de fazer o mapeamento das áreas prioritárias para conservação. Durante as obras, a Arauco vai oferecer capacitação e gerar mais de 14 mil oportunidades de trabalho. Depois do start up, o Projeto Sucuriú empregará cerca de 6 mil pessoas nas unidades Industrial, Florestal e operações de Logística. O propósito é impulsionar o desenvolvimento social e econômico para toda região, fomentando um aumento na geração de renda e na arrecadação de impostos, além de contribuir para atrair investimentos.

Sobre a Arauco Brasil

No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras. As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose brasileira em Inocência (MS). Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.

Sobre a Função

Desafios:

Operar e monitorar o Sistema Digital de Controle Distribuído (SDCD) Gaseificação, assegurando a produção contínua de syngas dentro das especificações, garantindo a eficiência energética no forno de cal, conhecimento desde a extração de biomassa até a alimentação dentro do reator, o funcionamento seguro de todo sistema (secagem, geração, sistema de cinzas, queimadores, inertização e sistema de leito fluidizado), contribuindo para a estabilidade do processo, geração de energéticos e a sustentabilidade. Interpretação e análise de diagramas de processo e instrumentação (P&ID), fluxogramas de engenharia e dados analíticos

Principais Atividades:

  • Operar e monitorar via SDCD o processo de gaseificação, garantindo estabilidade do sistema e a geração adequada de syngas para atendimento ao forno de cal.
  • Acompanhar continuamente parâmetros térmicos e operacionais (temperatura, leito fluidizado, qualidade e concentração do syngas), realizando ajustes necessários para manter eficiência e segurança.
  • Executar partidas, paradas e manobras operacionais conforme procedimentos, assegurando continuidade operacional e conformidade ambiental.
  • Identificar e diagnosticar alarmes e anomalias do processo de gaseificação, adotando ações corretivas iniciais e acionando operadores de campo e manutenção.
  • Registrar dados operacionais, elaborar relatórios de turno e acompanhar intervenções de manutenção pelo SDCD.
  • Manter comunicação ativa com supervisão, operadores de campo, manutenção, laboratório e Forno de Cal, garantindo operação integrada e segura.
  • Cumprir normas de segurança, ambientais, RCO e políticas internas, atuando preventivamente contra incidentes.
  • Participar de análises de causa, treinamentos técnicos e iniciativas de melhoria contínua.
  • Zelar pelo painel SDCD e demais sistemas de controle.
  • Executar outras atividades correlatas e garantir o cumprimento das políticas de Meio Ambiente, Qualidade, Segurança e Compliance.

Requisitos Obrigatórios:

  • Curso técnico completo em Papel e Celulose, Química, Eletrotécnica, Automação Industrial e/ou afins;
  • Desejável ensino superior em Administração, Engenharias e afins;
  • Conhecimento no Pacote Office, SAP, Ferramentas BI;
  • Vivência em Comissionamento e startup de plantas de Celulose e/ou Papel;
  • Conhecimento dos princípios químicos e operacionais dos processos de Caustificação (reações de NaOH, sulfidez, centrifugação, clarificação, filtração) e Forno de Cal (calcinação, balanço de massa e energia e combustão) e Gaseificação (Secagem da biomassa e processo de geração do syngas);
  • Domínio da operação do SDCD utilizado na fábrica (configuração, sequências, interlocks, controles, alarmes, tendências e lógicas de controle aplicadas à Caustificação, Forno de Cal e Gaseificação);
  • Conhecimento em instrumentação industrial (pressão, temperatura, vazão, nível, pH, condutividade, analisadores de gases);
  • Familiaridade com sistemas de manuseio de materiais em pó (cal, lama), sistemas de extração, secagem da biomassa e conceito de Gaseificação;
  • Conhecimento em operação de Caustificação e Forno de cal será um diferencial;
  • Inglês e Espanhol será um diferencial;

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
About the Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced a DevOps Engineer to support the transition of a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) backend system from a Proof of Concept (PoC) to a scalable, production-ready platform.

This role will focus on building, configuring, and deploying a serverless architecture leveraging AWS Bedrock, Lambda, API Gateway, RDS PostgreSQL, and other managed services.

You will collaborate closely with RedTeam’s existing .NET backend team to integrate a new Backend RAG API Service , enabling semantic search on construction specification documents through existing frontend applications.

Responsibilities

Infrastructure Provisioning

  • Execute curated deployment scripts using the AWS SDK.
  • Provision the full serverless architecture: API Gateway, Lambda, RDS (PostgreSQL), VPC components, and Bedrock Knowledge Base .

API Gateway Configuration

  • Deploy and configure RESTful API endpoints for chat query orchestration.
  • Ensure correct integration with the customer’s .NET API, where authentication/authorization is handled (no native AWS auth).

AWS Lambda Deployment

  • Deploy the API Orchestrator Lambda and the Ingestion & KB Sync Lambda functions.
  • Ensure Lambdas run inside the VPC and can be invoked by the customer’s .NET backend.

Networking & Security

  • Configure VPC networking, subnets, and access control for RDS connections.
  • Implement pragmatic least-privilege IAM policies for all components.

S3 Integration Setup

  • Configure Amazon S3 as the corpus data source for the AWS Bedrock Knowledge Base.
  • Enable automatic synchronization between the S3 bucket and the Knowledge Base.

Database Deployment

  • Deploy and configure the Amazon RDS PostgreSQL instance for chat history and conversation memory.
  • Execute necessary DDL changes and schema configuration.

Observability Setup

  • Configure CloudWatch logs and alarms for monitoring, troubleshooting, and operational health.

Required Qualifications

  • Strong hands-on experience with AWS Serverless Architecture (Lambda, API Gateway, S3, DynamoDB or RDS).
  • Experience provisioning AWS environments using AWS SDK, IaC scripts, or automated deployment pipelines .
  • Proficiency with VPC networking, IAM security policies , and integrating private Lambdas with RDS.
  • Knowledge of RDS (PostgreSQL) administration and schema deployment.
  • Experience with CloudWatch for logging, metrics, and alarm configuration.
  • Ability to integrate backend services with external APIs, especially .NET-based systems.

Nice to Have Skills

  • Experience with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures.
  • Familiarity with AWS Bedrock , Bedrock Knowledge Base, and generative AI workloads.
  • Working knowledge of semantic search , embeddings, or vector-based search systems.
  • Experience with .NET backend integration or hybrid cloud/backend environments.
  • Exposure to infra-as-code tools (CloudFormation, CDK, Terraform).
  • Background in serverless best practices , scalability, and production hardening.

title: Financial Planning Analyst
description:
What is Teachable?

Teachable is trusted by creator-educators around the world to grow their impact and income. From online courses and communities to memberships and downloads, Teachable's digital learning products help creator-educators drive meaningful connection and sustainable revenue. With industry-best ecommerce tools, easily toggled on directly within the platform, creators can confidently maximize their earnings, while getting paid directly by their audience. Teachable's unmatched focus on the student learning experience also ensures creators can make a positive and influential impact on their communities—entirely on their own terms. Today, tens of thousands of creator-educators use Teachable to share their knowledge, reaching millions of students around the world. To learn more, visit teachable.com.

Are you ready to join a dynamic, cross-cultural team at an exciting turning point in our company’s journey? Now part of the global portfolio, whose platforms have helped creators earn more than $10 billion, Teachable continues to take the creator economy by storm as a true industry leader. Together, Teachable and Hotmart are delivering market-leading products that prioritize creator control and flexibility, alongside meaningful partnership and support from our team. If you have big ideas, relish the chance to challenge convention, and deeply believe in the power of creators to shape the future, we want you on our team!

What is this role?

Strong financial analysis and forecasting enables Teachable to determine how best to deploy our resources to continue (and accelerate) our growth. We’re looking for an FP&A analystwith a strong sense of ownership who can assess the opportunities ahead of us and help Teachable make sound business decisions. This position reports to the FP&A Manager and will be heavily involved in various finance needs of the company, with an emphasis on financial reporting, forecasting, cross-department partnerships, and data integrity,

You will have full visibility of Teachable’s P&L focused on labour spend, and build reports to monitor our labour financial performance and help identify opportunities. You will be responsible for deeply understanding and managing the labour model, labour KPIs, unit economics and forecasting models.

If you enjoy the challenge of transforming business questions into financial models and are passionate about the creator economy, we want you on our Finance team at Teachable!

What You’ll Do:

  • Own Teachable Monthly Labour process, including updating actuals and forecasts;
  • Support the buildup of labour-related Balance Sheet accounts and Cash Flow statements and own the monthly updates and analyses.
  • Collaborate with HR and various teams on workforce planning, analyzing financial data, and develop actionable insights.
  • Own labour reporting package consolidated by our FP&A team and sent to our parent company, Hotmart, on a monthly basis.
  • Be the focal point for all labour cost data and partner closely with HR team to develop reports and dashboards for financial and other business needs.
  • Provide continuous improvements on tools and analysis methodologies, elevating visibility to key stakeholders.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in relevant fields (Business, Economics, Finance, Engineering, Accounting)
  • 3+ years of experience in FP&A, Business Operations or HR Finance Business Partner
  • Strong modeling (Excel) skills
  • Ability to handle multiple projects and to analyze a big volume of data and support on reporting results to senior leadership
  • Strategic data analysis, BI tooling, SQL and database experience (Sigma) a plus
  • Excited to work independently and chart your own course, while knowing when to seek guidance

While Teachable maintains our NY office for local employees to use, we operate as a remote-first culture in order to give our employees added flexibility. In order to maintain connection and create a community beyond the screen, Teachable holds in-person events throughout the year, where employees and teams can come together for bonding, strategic alignment, goal-setting, and celebrations!

  • Apoiar áreas internas como Pesquisa, Regulatório e Supply com informações e aprendizados dos ensaios.
  • Conduzir e monitorar os telados, assegurando manutenção, biossegurança e padrões experimentais.

Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Formação em Agronomia, Biologia ou áreas afins.
  • Disponibilidade para atividades em campo e viagens para polos de pesquisa.
  • Atenção a detalhes, organização e disciplina no registro de dados.
  • Capacidade de seguir protocolos técnicos e trabalhar de forma integrada com outras áreas.
  • Excel avançado e Familiaridade com uso de sistemas de registro.

You will define how data is collected, structured, and leveraged for credit decisioning, business insights, and AI deployment , ensuring that data becomes a core enabler for smarter, faster lending decisions.

  • Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Data Science teams to ensure data integrity, accessibility, and usability .
  • Define data requirements for new products, features, and risk models.
  • Build dashboards and metrics to monitor portfolio performance and business health.
  • Enable AI and ML model deployment by ensuring high-quality, structured, and real-time data availability.
  • Partner with compliance and BI teams to ensure data governance and regulatory alignment.

Key Requirements:

  • 5+ years of experience in data or product management roles within lending, BNPL, or fintech ecosystems .
  • Strong understanding of credit data, decision engines, and lending workflows .
  • Experience with data platforms, APIs, and BI tools (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery, Power BI, or Looker).
  • Familiarity with AI/ML use cases in credit risk, collections, and personalization .
  • Strong analytical mindset with ability to translate business needs into scalable data solutions.
  • Proven cross-functional collaboration skills with product, data, and risk teams.

description:
A Iguatemi Empresa de Shopping Centers S.A. é uma das maiores empresas full service no setor de shopping centers do Brasil. Responsável pela comercialização dos espaços das lojas (SUCs: salão de uso comercial) nos shoppings de sua responsabilidade, maximizando a geração de receitas, superando as metas de redução de vacância estipuladas, substituindo operações não sadias e que não sejam aderentes ao mix do empreendimento, com objetivo de atingir ou superar o orçamento. Prospecção de novos clientes com perfil desejado para atuar nos empreendimentos a serem comercializados, e apresentar a empresa e a área de mix.

RESPONSABILIDADES PRINCIPAIS - O quê e como ?

  • Comercialização das áreas vagas: prospecção de novos lojistas, análise SWOT dos espaços ofertados, negociações de valores e condições contratuais com lojistas, acompanhamento após a assinatura do contrato;
  • Estabelecer contato inicial com lojista: prospecção do contato comercial referente à marca indicada pelo Mix, apresentação da oportunidade para o lojista e captura de interesse preliminar do mesmo, agendamento e realização de reuniões;
  • Negociação: Elaboração da proposta comercial (Salesforce) com base nas metas definidas pela Iguatemi, apresentação da proposta para o lojista e negociação da mesma, ajustes na proposta comercial se necessário, atualização do status de cada negociação no sistema, envio de informações técnicas sobre o SUC e levantamento junto ao lojista de eventuais necessidades de alterações para serem aprovadas e discutidas com demais áreas;
  • Acompanhar o andamento da proposta comercial no fluxo de aprovações e, após alçadas de aprovações internas, efetuar o retorno para o lojista;
  • Fechamento: Coleta de documentação e assinatura de contrato do lojista, entrega dos documentos para a equipe de operações comerciais responsável pelos inputs de dados cadastrais;
  • Acompanhamento: Uma vez assinado o contrato, apresentar o lojista à equipe de operações e manutenção, efetuar o acompanhamento da obra periodicamente de modo a garantir abertura da loja;
  • Uma vez que a loja esteja aberta, realizar as boas vindas ao lojista e passagem de bastão para área de operações.;
  • Alimentar a base de contatos de lojistas do Iguatemi (Salesforce), fazendo inputs de dados cadastrais do mesmo (completando o que é previamente enviado por mix);

title: Senior Sales Executive (Freight Forwarder / NVOCC)
description:
About Seafrigo

We are Seafrigo, a global French logistics company with over 40 years of experience, specialized in temperature-controlled logistics, focused in the food industry.

With our global headquarters in Le Havre, France, we operate across all five continents through 26 offices, with a strong presence in the world’s leading perishable cargo markets, delivering tailored and reliable solutions to our customers worldwide.

About the Position

We are looking for a Sales Executive to join our team in Brazil, based in Santos, SP, supporting our commercial activities in the Southeast region and supporting the growth of our business. This role provides the opportunity to work in a dynamic, international environment, with a strong focus on results and professional development.

The ideal candidate will be responsible for building and maintaining a strong sales pipeline. You will do so by identifying key business opportunities and segmented prospects. Your goal will be to meet or exceed our annual quota and increase our revenue.

Responsibilities

  • Manage, maintain, and expand the client portfolio, focused on long-term relationships.
  • Identify new business opportunities through active prospecting and field visits.
  • Lead commercial negotiations, including proposal preparation and sales strategy definition.
  • Develop the refrigerated cargo (reefer) client portfolio in line with the Commercial Manager’s strategic direction.
  • Actively participate in industry fairs and events, representing the company and expanding professional networks.
  • Update and monitor weekly and monthly sales reports, ensuring control of key commercial KPIs.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Foreign Trade, International Relations, Business Administration, or related fields.
  • Valid driver’s license (Category B) and availability for client and external visits.
  • Proven experience in field sales and/or commercial support, preferably within freight forwarders or NVOCCs.
  • Strong understanding of the perishable cargo market, especially fruits and proteins.
  • Excellent negotiation, communication, and relationship-building skills.
  • Consultative, strategic, and results-driven profile.
  • Advanced English proficiency to work in an international environment.
  • Previous commercial experience with Freight Forwarders or NVOCCs in the refrigerated (reefer) cargo segment.
  • An established client portfolio.
  • Passion for logistics solutions focused on refrigerated cargo transportation.
  • Knowledge of dry cargo is an advantage. This role also offers opportunities to develop sales and volumes in this segment.

Benefits We Offer

  • Ticket Refeição / Alimentação
  • Vale Transporte
  • Health and dental insurance
  • Life insurance
  • Performance-based bonus
  • Hybrid position
  • Positive and supportive work environment

title: Lead Data Platform Architect
description:
Lead Data Platform Architect

Mars is a family-owned business with more than $50 billion in global sales. We produce some of the world’s best-loved brands: M&M’s®, SNICKERS®, TWIX®, MILKY WAY®, DOVE®, PEDIGREE®, ROYAL CANIN®, WHISKAS®, EXTRA®, ORBIT®, 5™, SKITTLES®, BEN’S ORIGINAL®, and COCOAVIA®. Alongside our consumer brands, we proudly take care of half of the world’s pets through our nutrition, health and services businesses such as Banfield Pet Hospitals™, BluePearl®, Linnaeus, AniCura, VCA™ and Pet Partners™. Headquartered in McLean, VA, Mars operates in more than 80 countries. The Mars Five Principles – Quality, Responsibility, Mutuality, Efficiency and Freedom – inspire our 160,000 Diverse Associates to act daily towards creating the world we want tomorrow.

The Lead Data Platform Architect is instrumental in delivering scalable, repeatable and agile data and platform architectures to unlock and drive business value across Finance, Commercial, R&D, MGS Labs and Innovation:

As the Lead Data Platform Architect in the Enterprise Data & Platform team, your key responsibilities are as follows:

TECHNICAL PROFICIENCY AND LEADERSHIP

  • Lead the definition and execution of data architecture strategies across multiple business domains and data platforms.
  • Drive the development of scalable, integrated data models and architectures across raw, trusted, and harmonized zones.
  • Define and execute the data product strategy for assigned business areas in collaboration with analytics and business teams.
  • Act as a thought leader and trusted advisor, supporting teams in understanding business objectives, data requirements, processes, and enabling technologies.
  • Ensure all data architecture efforts are aligned with the broader business vision and strategic priorities and provide architectural oversight across delivery initiatives.
  • Collaborate with other data architects to ensure consistent and integrated use of data assets across the organization.
  • Identify cross-segment and cross-function data dependencies or issues and lead resolution efforts.
  • Provide strategic guidance on data domains, process analysis, data analysis, and modelling techniques.
  • Mentor and coach solution / data architects and engineers to build internal data architecture capability.
  • Advocate for best practices, tools, and methods related to data architecture.
  • Ensure understanding and compliance of data protection policies, security policies, and GDPR

DELIVERABLE INVOLVEMENT & OWNERSHIP

  • Reference Architectures: Own and maintain reusable architectural patterns
  • High-Level Designs (HLDs): Review and approve HLDs from Solution Architects and 3rd parties
  • Key Design Decisions (KDDs): Own and govern major architectural decisions for alignment with the Architecture Review Board and beyond
  • Architecture Option Assessments: Lead decisioning on tooling, modelling, and patterns

DATA & PLATFORM ARCHITECTURE OWNERSHIP

  • Develop and maintain current and future state data architectures, models, and roadmaps.
  • Promote awareness and understanding of data architectures across the organization.
  • Review and validate high-level models and reference architecture libraries
  • Approve changes to shared or enterprise-wide data models

Knowledge and Experience

ESSENTIAL:

  • Previous experience as a Senior Data or Platform Architect essential
  • Proven experience as a senior data or platform architect, or similar leadership role in data & platform strategy.
  • Strong background in data modelling, architecture frameworks, and modern data integration methods.
  • Deep understanding of cloud-based data platforms (Azure) and tools (Databricks, SQL, ADF etc) as well as analytics solutions.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence and align across business and technology functions.
  • Experience building and evolving data & platform architectures that scale and adapt to changing business needs.
  • Passion for coaching and enabling others with a collaborative leadership approach.
  • Knowledgeable in Data Source systems (eg. SAP) and Data Lake technology
  • Stakeholder management and communication skills
  • Strong interpersonal skills
  • Fluent in writing and speaking English

DESIRED:

  • Previous experience in CPG industry would be ideal
  • Experience at operating in a complex global matrix organisation
  • Experience at collaborating with cross-functional partners
  • High drive for results and an ability to work with minimum input

What can you expect from Mars?

  • Work with diverse and talented Associates, all guided by the Five Principles.
  • Join a purpose-driven company, where we’re striving to build the world we want tomorrow, today.
  • Best-in-class learning and development support from day one, including access to our in-house Mars University.
  • An industry-competitive salary and benefits package, including a company bonus.

Mars is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. If you need assistance or an accommodation during the application process because of a disability, it is available upon request. The company is pleased to provide such assistance, and no applicant will be penalized as a result of such a request.

title: Indirect Tax Manager

  3. Monitor tax compliance processes and work closely with internal accounting and finance teams to ensure tax obligations are met.
  4. Manage and respond to federal, state, and municipal tax audits, including coordinating documentation and liaising with auditors and tax authorities.
  5. Analyze changes in Brazilian tax legislation and assess potential business impacts, providing recommendations for compliance.

Desired profile

  1. Education: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or Law. Advanced degree or CPA certification preferred.
  2. Solid experience in indirect taxes, tax compliance and tax planning;

Apply today to join Temu and be part of a dynamic and innovative company.

title: Computational Scientist
description:
We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.

Job Duties

We seek a talented Computational Scientist with an M.Sc. in Computational Science or Engineering and academic and/or professional experience. A Ph.D. degree with a strong background in Computational Science is a plus. The ideal candidate for this position is an expert in porting complex scientific programming codes to parallel hybrid (CPU+GPU) clusters. You must have a passion for optimizing and improving code speed-up. Excellent problem-solving ability and good oral and written communication skills in both English and Portuguese are required.

You will join a multidisciplinary and diverse team of scientists and engineers committed to delivering high-end computational technologies and tools for the O&G and broader Energy industry.

Qualifications

  • Expert knowledge of modern C++ (e.g., C++11, C++14, C++17).
  • Expert knowledge of GPGPU frameworks/software layers such as CUDA and OpenCL.
  • Expert knowledge of distributed and parallel computing in hybrid (CPU and GPU) clusters.
  • Good knowledge of device-level optimization and GPU architecture.
  • Good knowledge of modern C++ design patterns and software engineering concepts (e.g., template metaprogramming, generic programming, etc.).
  • Ability to work in both Windows and Linux environments.
  • Some experience with programming/scripting languages such as Python and Matlab.
  • Some experience with MPI programming.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Proven experience porting legacy serial or MPI/OpenMP code to GPUs.
  • Knowledge of scientific computing (e.g., linear and nonlinear solvers, numerical methods, etc.).
  • Familiarity with computational mathematics (e.g., linear algebra, calculus, matrix decompositions, etc.).
  • Knowledge of PDE discretization methods, such as Finite Element, Finite Volume, or Lattice Boltzmann.
  • Familiarity with open-source scientific computing libraries (e.g., HYPRE, BOOST++, PETSC, DUNE, LAPACK, etc.).
  • Familiarity with CMake, Makefiles, and other tools for multi-platform code compilation.
  • Knowledge of fluid flow physics.

title: Senior Data Scientist / ML Engineer
description:
Project Description:

The primary goal of the project is the modernization, maintenance and development of an eCommerce platform for a big US-based retail company, serving millions of omnichannel customers each week.

Solutions are delivered by several Product Teams focused on different domains - Customer, Loyalty, Search and Browse, Data Integration, Cart.

Current overriding priorities are new brands onboarding, re-architecture, database migrations, migration of microservices to a unified cloud-native solution without any disruption to business.

  • - Design, develop, and optimize semantic and vector-based search solutions leveraging Lucene/Solr and modern embeddings.
  • - Apply machine learning, deep learning, and natural language processing techniques to improve search relevance and ranking.
  • - Develop scalable data pipelines and APIs for indexing, retrieval, and model inference.
  • - Integrate ML models and search capabilities into production systems.
  • - Evaluate, fine-tune, and monitor search performance metrics.
  • - Collaborate with software engineers, data engineers, and product teams to translate business needs into technical implementations.
  • - Stay current with advancements in search technologies, LLMs, and semantic retrieval frameworks.

Mandatory Skills Description:

  • 5+ years of experience in Data Science or Machine Learning Engineering, with a focus on Information Retrieval or Semantic Search.
  • Strong programming experience in both Java and Python (production-level code, not just prototyping).
  • Deep knowledge of Lucene, Apache Solr, or Elasticsearch (indexing, query tuning, analyzers, scoring models).
  • Experience with Vector Databases, Embeddings, and Semantic Search techniques.
  • Strong understanding of NLP techniques (tokenization, embeddings, transformers, etc.).
  • Experience deploying and maintaining ML/search systems in production.
  • Solid understanding of software engineering best practices (CI/CD, testing, version control, code review).

Languages:

  • English: B2 Upper Intermediate

title: Senior Key Account Executive
description:

Keeta is the international arm of Meituan , one of the world’s leading delivery platforms. We’re on a mission to revolutionize how people access food and daily essentials globally.   • Python scripting for network automation and tooling
  • Experience creating and managing Jinja2 templates for network configuration

title: Analista de Dados Sênior
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls , em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

Atividades:

  • Coletar e limpar dados, identificando fontes relevantes e tratando valores ausentes e outliers;
  • Aplicar conceitos e ferramentas de digital analytics: GA4, firebase, GTM, Big Query;
  • Desenvolver dashboards, queries, algorítmos para monitorar e melhorar a performance dos processos;
  • Ser propritário de sua frente de negócio, planejando e priorizando as atividades de acordo com as necessidades de negócio e do valor de suas entregas para Allos;
  • Traduzir problemas de negócios em termos analíticos e facilitar tomadas de decisão para resolução destes problemas;
  • Propor pró-ativamente soluções técnicas e de negócio;
  • Ser pró-ativo na garantia de segurança e privacidade dos dados, cumprindo regulamentações.

Requisitos:

  • Formação em tecnologia, ciências exatas/biológicas com foco em tecnologia ou experiência comprovada na área de banco de dados;
  • Experiência em Data Analytics, Big Query/Databricks;
  • Conhecimento Avançado em análise de dados e estatística intermediário (Amostragem, Teste de Hipótese, Inferência).
  • SQL (DQL, DDL) Avançado.;
  • Conhecimento Intermediário linguagens como JavaScript, Python ou R. Experiencia em extração de dados, ingestão e transformação;
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de BI (Tableau, Power BI).

Nossos benefícios:

  • Vale Transporte/Estacionamento;
  • Plano de Saúde;

title: Senior Functional Engineer
description:

Founded in 1984, our client is one of the world's leading provider of lithography systems for the semiconductor industry, manufacturing complex machines that are critical to the production of integrated circuits or chips. The client has its R&D and manufacturing operations in The Netherlands.

We are looking for Metrology engineers who are experts in requirements engineering and challenged by translating functional requirements into lean functional designs. We need highly motivated new colleagues who combine strong analytical reasoning and conceptual understanding with excellent communication skills.

• Enabling the realization of new functionality by interacting with specialist software designers in the project team.

• Integrating and testing the function against the specification.

• Ability to influence without power.

English: C1 Advanced

title: Cortex Cloud Sales Specialist - FSI
description:
Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks® everything starts and ends with our mission:

Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life. Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.

Who We Are

We believe collaboration thrives in person. That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed. This model supports real-time problem-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes. Job Description

Your Career:

We are seeking a dynamic and experienced Sales Specialist to drive the growth of our Cortex and Cloud business to cover strategic and major accounts in the private sector, mainly in Sao Paolo.

The ideal candidate will operate in a high-growth environment at scale, thrive in driving innovation, have a solid background in cybersecurity sales, and a deep understanding of security solutions. They will have a proven track record of developing strong customer relationships and executing strategies that support rapid expansion and success. This role requires a strategic thinker who excels in collaboration with internal teams, engages effectively with customers, and drives revenue growth through the sale of complex solutions.

Your Impact:

  • Join the fastest growing team where experience meets cutting-edge solutions

  • Build and cultivate strong customer relationships, driving business growth within the region.

  • Partner with the core sales team to align customer strategies and engagements with Cortex and Cloud business objectives.

  • Take full ownership of leading strategic sales campaigns, sales forecasting, utilizing in-depth knowledge of sales cycles from initial contact through procurement.

  • Engage in deep technical discussions beyond standard sales presentations and pitches; while translating complex technical cybersecurity solutions into clear business value propositions for customers.

  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including sales engineers, to provide tailored customer-centric solutions.

  • Partner with Alliances to develop joint strategies, enhance customer engagement and deliver innovative solutions for existing and prospective clients.

  • Travel domestically as needed to meet with customers and attend key business events.

Qualifications

Your Experience

  • 5+ years of field sales experience focusing on key customer accounts and delivering value to Enterprise or Major-level accounts.

  • Extensive platform selling experience in complex sales with multiple buying centers.

  • Experience selling Cybersecurity, SIEM, EDR or CNAPP (DevSecOps, CloudOps) solutions is highly preferred.

  • Established trusted relationships with CIOs and CISOs with the ability to influence and drive strategic conversations

  • Expertise in applying complex solution sales methodologies to drive results.

  • Experience working with channel partners and a deep understanding of a channel-centric go-to-market strategy.

  • Demonstrated ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth startup environment while collaborating effectively with sales engineers and cross-functional teams.

  • Experience operating in a continuous adoption, expansion, and upsell sales motion within a matrixed sales organization is preferred

  • Willingness to travel domestically as necessary to meet business needs.

Additional Information

The Team

Our sales team members work hand-in-hand with large organizations around the world to keep their digital environments protected. We educate, inspire, and empower our potential clients in their journey to security.

As part of our sales team, you are empowered with unmatched systems and tools, constantly updated research and sales libraries, and a team built on joint success. You won't find someone at Palo Alto Networks that isn't committed to your success with everyone pitching in to assist when it comes to solutions selling, learning, and development. As a member of our sales team, you are driven by a solutions-focused sales environment and find fulfillment in working with clients to resolve incredibly complex cyberthreats. You are an amazing salesperson - you are just looking for something more substantial and challenging as your next step.

Our Commitment
We’re problem solvers that take risks and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at

Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

title: Sales Development Representative
description:
Company Description

MonetizeMail.co - We help scale DTC ecommerce brands using email marketing. We're passionate about helping brands make a real impact through email marketing. Whether you're looking to drive sales, build brand awareness, or increase customer engagement, we've got the expertise and creative energy to make it happen.

Role Description

We are seeking a dedicated and motivated Sales Development Representative (SDR) for a full-time remote position, with a specific focus on cold calling. As an SDR, you will play a crucial role in our inside sales activities and lead generation efforts. Your primary responsibility will be to identify and qualify potential clients through cold calling, initiate contact, and nurture relationships to drive sales. This role requires effective communication with clients and close collaboration with the sales and business development teams to achieve sales targets.

Responsibilities

Conduct cold calling to identify and qualify potential clients

Initiate contact and build relationships with prospective clients

Effectively communicate the value proposition of our products/services

Nurture leads through follow-ups and relationship-building activities

Collaborate with the sales and business development teams to achieve sales targets

Maintain accurate records of lead interactions and sales activities in the CRM system

Compensation

Our compensation structure is designed to reward both consistent effort and exceptional performance. As a Sales Development Representative, you will receive:

Base Salary: $300 per month

Commission: 15% of Revenue Generated.

Performance Fee: $10-25 per qualified sales call generated

Expected Salary: $2000 per month

This structure ensures that you have a stable base income while also providing the opportunity to significantly increase your earnings based on your success in generating qualified leads.

Additional Information

This job opportunity includes detailed standard operating procedures (SOPs) that cover any questions or details needed to successfully book qualified calls at scale. These SOPs provide comprehensive guidance to ensure your success. There is significant room for growth as an SDR/Cold Caller at MonetizeMail, where you could advance to become a Sales Development Manager and lead teams based on your experience and performance.

title: FPGA Engineer (Brazil) | Engenheiro(a) de FPGA (Brasil)
description:
The Opportunity

Grass Valley’s FPGA Engineers develop state-of-the -art solutions for content creation, transmission, and distribution. We are dedicated to redefining the way audiences experience entertainment and information through cutting-edge technology. We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced FPGA Engineer specializing in Broadcast Video and Audio to join our team. As a FPGA Engineer, you will be instrumental in the design, development, testing and implementation of FPGA-based solutions specifically tailored for broadcast video and audio applications. Your responsibilities will encompass leading FPGA architecture design, electronic and PCB design and collaborating with cross-functional teams to integrate these solutions into our broadcast systems.

Your Role

  • Lead the architecture, design, and development of FPGA-based systems for broadcast video and audio applications, focusing on Embedded System hardware and electronic design;
  • Optimize FPGA designs to enhance video processing, audio synchronization and develop electronic systems with FPGA architectures;
  • Conduct thorough simulation, testing, debugging, and verification of FPGA designs to ensure seamless functionality and adherence to industry standards;
  • Maintain and improve FPGA build processes using CI/CD tools like Jenkins;
  • Estimate work effort to establish schedules for design delivery;
  • Stay updated on industry trends, emerging standards, and technologies related to broadcast video and audio.

Who you are

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related technical field;
  • Two (2) to five (5) years experience in FPGA design and development with strong focus on electronic and PCB design;
  • Proficiency in FPGA design, power estimation, implementation, optimization, testing, and development using hardware description languages (HDL) such as VHDL or Verilog;
  • Ability to simulate and verify FPGA designs using tools like Questa;
  • Familiarity with FPGA development tools such as Xilinx Vivado, or Altera Quartus;
  • Proficiency in debugging and troubleshooting FPGA designs, including using logic analyzers and other debugging tools;
  • Ability to create clear and concise documentation for FPGA designs, including design specifications;
  • Experience with embedded system integration and real-time operating systems running on inhouse designed hardware;
  • Experience in high-speed digital design, data serialization, media streaming (ST2110) and transmission protocols within the broadcast industry, particularly HD-SDI video;
  • Experience with high-speed serial interfaces like PCIe, DDR, Ethernet, and USB;
  • Knowledge of communication protocols such as SPI, I2C, UART, and CAN;
  • Strong understanding of digital logic design principles and ability to create complex digital circuits;
  • Proficiency in scripting languages such as Python and programming languages C/C++ for FPGA programming and automation;
  • Understanding TCP/IP from network programming perspective;
  • Experience in managing code with version control systems like Git to track releases and collaborate with a team through branching and merging;
  • Strong teamwork and communication skills to collaborate effectively with cross-functional multi-site teams, including hardware engineers, QA engineers, and project managers;
  • Proven experience in hardware design and development, preferably in a similar role;
  • Experience with hardware debug and tests;
  • Strong knowledge of analog and digital electronics, microcontrollers, and FPGA;
  • Familiarity with industry standards, regulations, and compliance related to hardware design;
  • Proficiency in schematic capture and oversight of PCB layout;
  • Fluency in English, both oral and written.

Working Conditions

  • Competitive Compensation packages
  • Energizing and supportive work environment
  • Remote work
  • This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work involved for this job. It is not an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and skills required of this job.
  • Grass Valley is an equal opportunity employer and makes employment decisions without regard to gender, marital status, race, religion, colour, age, disability, sexual orientation or protected veteran status.

Oportunidade

Os Engenheiros FPGA da Grass Valley desenvolvem soluções de ponta para criação, transmissão e distribuição de conteúdo. Somos dedicados a redefinir a forma como as audiências vivenciam entretenimento e informação por meio de tecnologia inovadora.

Estamos buscando um(a) Engenheiro(a) FPGA altamente qualificado(a) e experiente, especializado(a) em Vídeo e Áudio Broadcast, para integrar nossa equipe. Como Engenheiro(a) FPGA você será fundamental no design, desenvolvimento, teste e implementação de soluções baseadas em FPGA, especificamente voltadas para aplicações de Vídeo e Áudio Broadcast. Suas responsabilidades incluirão liderar o design de arquitetura FPGA, design eletrônico e de PCB, além de colaborar com equipes multifuncionais para integrar essas soluções aos nossos sistemas de transmissão.

Função

  • Liderar a arquitetura, design e desenvolvimento de sistemas baseados em FPGA para aplicações de vídeo e áudio broadcast, com foco em hardware de sistemas embarcados e design eletrônico;
  • Otimizar designs FPGA para aprimorar o processamento de vídeo, sincronização de áudio e desenvolver sistemas eletrônicos com arquiteturas FPGA;
  • Realizar simulação, testes, depuração e verificação detalhada dos designs FPGA para garantir funcionalidade perfeita e conformidade com padrões da indústria;
  • Manter e melhorar processos de build FPGA usando ferramentas CI/CD como Jenkins;
  • Estimar esforço de trabalho para estabelecer cronogramas de entrega de design;
  • Manter-se atualizado sobre tendências da indústria, padrões emergentes e tecnologias relacionadas a vídeo e áudio broadcast.

Quem é você

  • Graduado em Engenharia Elétrica, Engenharia da Computação ou área técnica relacionada;
  • De 2 a 5 anos de experiência em design e desenvolvimento FPGA com forte foco em design eletrônico e de PCB;
  • Proficiência em design FPGA, estimativa de consumo, implementação, otimização, testes e desenvolvimento usando linguagens de descrição de hardware (HDL) como VHDL ou Verilog;
  • Capacidade de simular e verificar designs FPGA usando ferramentas como Questa;
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de desenvolvimento FPGA como Xilinx Vivado ou Altera Quartus;
  • Proficiência em depuração e solução de problemas em designs FPGA, incluindo uso de analisadores lógicos e outras ferramentas de debug;
  • Capacidade de criar documentação clara e concisa para designs FPGA, incluindo especificações de design;
  • Experiência com integração de sistemas embarcados e sistemas operacionais em tempo real rodando em hardware desenvolvido internamente;
  • Experiência em design digital de alta velocidade, serialização de dados, streaming de mídia (ST2110) e protocolos de transmissão na indústria broadcast, especialmente vídeo HD-SDI;
  • Experiência com interfaces seriais de alta velocidade como PCIe, DDR, Ethernet e USB;
  • Conhecimento de protocolos de comunicação como SPI, I2C, UART e CAN;
  • Forte compreensão dos princípios de design lógico digital e capacidade de criar circuitos digitais complexos;
  • Proficiência em linguagens de script como Python e linguagens de programação C/C++ para programação FPGA e automação;
  • Compreensão de TCP/IP sob a perspectiva de programação de rede;
  • Experiência em gerenciamento de código com sistemas de controle de versão como Git para rastrear releases e colaborar com a equipe por meio de branching e merging;
  • Fortes habilidades de trabalho em equipe e comunicação para colaborar efetivamente com equipes multifuncionais distribuídas, incluindo engenheiros de hardware, QA e gerentes de projeto;
  • Experiência comprovada em design e desenvolvimento de hardware, preferencialmente em função similar;
  • Experiência com debug e testes de hardware;
  • Sólido conhecimento em eletrônica analógica e digital, microcontroladores e FPGA;
  • Familiaridade com padrões da indústria, regulamentações e conformidade relacionadas ao design de hardware;
  • Proficiência em captura esquemática e supervisão de layout de PCB;
  • Fluência em inglês, oral e escrita.

title: Analista de Customer Experience
description:
Analista de Customer Experience

Quem somos

A Busbud é um grupo líder global em mobilidade focado em viagens interurbanas terrestres, com a missão de transformar a forma como as pessoas se conectam em todo o mundo. O grupo opera um mercado B2C focado na reserva de viagens interurbanas terrestres (ônibus, trem, caronas compartilhadas e muito mais), utilizado por mais de 100 milhões de viajantes em mais de 3 milhões de rotas em mais de 80 países. A empresa também oferece software SaaS B2B vertical que impulsiona os negócios de centenas de operadores de viagens terrestres em todo o mundo. Capacitamos os viajantes a descobrir novos destinos, construir conexões e experimentar o mundo — tudo isso enquanto fazem escolhas ambientalmente conscientes, promovendo um modo de transporte mais sustentável e acessível. Esta função está especificamente focada na Buson, nossa plataforma regional de mobilidade que torna as viagens de ônibus no Brasil mais inteligentes, acessíveis e convenientes.

A função

Buscamos um profissional para atuar no atendimento aos passageiros, garantindo suporte ágil e de qualidade. Será responsável por realizar trocas e cancelamentos de passagens, acompanhar solicitações e oferecer um atendimento multicanal humanizado, contribuindo para uma experiência positiva do cliente.

O que irá fazer

  • Realizar o atendimento das demandas internas relacionadas aos passageiros, garantindo agilidade e qualidade no suporte.
  • Executar cancelamentos e trocas de passagens, além de realizar a análise detalhada de pedidos.
  • Administrar e acompanhar tickets abertos por passageiros, assegurando a resolução dentro dos prazos estabelecidos.
  • Prestar atendimento aos clientes por meio de diversos canais, como telefone, WhatsApp, e-mail, entre outros, proporcionando uma experiência eficiente e humanizada.
  • Realizar atendimento personalizado ao cliente de novos produtos, esclarecendo dúvidas, oferecendo suporte e garantindo uma experiência positiva na utilização das soluções oferecidas.

O que buscamos

  • Atendimento ao SAC.
  • Análise de casos.
  • Vivência com atendimento multicanal.
  • Relacionamento com cliente.
  • Conhecimento intermediário no pacote office.
  • Customer Service (SAC).

  • Benefício flexível por meio do cartão Swile;
  • Assistência médica Bradesco e odontológica com cobertura nacional;
  • Cultura remota em primeiro lugar: uma cultura colaborativa e inclusiva criada para equipes distribuídas
  • Ambiente descontraído e dinâmico;
  • Benefícios Sesc
  • Day Offs programados.
  • Fundo de bem-estar: subsídio anual para apoiar o seu bem-estar físico, mental e emocional

A Busbud está comprometida com a igualdade de oportunidades de emprego para todos os funcionários e com a promoção de um ambiente de trabalho livre de discriminação e assédio. Todas as decisões de emprego na Busbud são baseadas nas necessidades da empresa, nos requisitos do cargo e nas qualificações individuais, independentemente de raça, cor, religião ou crença, nacionalidade, gênero, idade, deficiência, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, estado civil ou qualquer outra condição protegida pelas leis aplicáveis.

Who We Are

Busbud is a global leader in ground travel mobility, with a mission to transform the way people connect around the world.

The group operates a B2C marketplace focused on booking intercity ground travel (bus, train, ridesharing, and more), used by over 100 million travelers across more than 3 million routes in over 80 countries.

The company also offers vertical B2B SaaS software that powers the businesses of hundreds of ground travel operators worldwide.

We empower travelers to discover new destinations, build connections, and experience the world, all while making environmentally conscious choices and promoting a more sustainable and accessible mode of transportation.

This role is specifically focused on Buson , our regional mobility platform that makes bus travel in Brazil smarter, more accessible, and more convenient.

The Role

This person will be responsible for processing ticket changes and cancellations, managing requests, and providing humanized, multichannel support — contributing to a positive customer experience.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Manage and monitor tickets opened by passengers, ensuring resolution within established deadlines.
  • Provide customer service through multiple channels such as phone, WhatsApp, email, and others, delivering an efficient and humanized experience.
  • Offer personalized support for new products, addressing inquiries, providing assistance, and ensuring a positive experience with the offered solutions.

description:
Job Title: Treasury Specialist LATAM | Samsung Electronics

Highlights :

  • Location: São Paulo - SP

Who are we?

Samsung Electronics has grown into one of the world’s leading technology companies, recognized as one of the top 5 global brands. As a global leader in technology, we are transforming the world with the creativity and diversity of our talented people who drive this transformation.

Our company's success reflects the determination and talent of our people, aligned with our key corporate values: People, Excellence, Change, Integrity, and Co-prosperity. Our mission is to help people achieve the impossible.

We are inspired by what people want to accomplish in their lives and work to create products that empower them in new ways. This drive fuels our innovation.

Join us at Samsung and find your opportunity to do what you can't.

Looking for more? Visit our website or our career page !

Job Description

Samsung is looking for a proactive, detailed-oriented candidate with a great sense of ownership to join our team located in São Paulo.

Treasury Specialist will provide support in supervising and overseeing treasury operations of Latin America subsidiaries. The special part of this position is that this role will be very dynamic. Some examples of activities that the candidate would be involved would be cash, FX, credit, and Treasury risk management, economic/political risk factors and forecast analysis, and consumer installment payment solution management. The position requires fluency in English and knowledge of Spanish is a huge plus as the candidate will liaise with banking partners and subsidiaries including those of Spanish speaking countries on various treasury matters described above.

Key Job Responsabilities

  • Cash Liquidity Management across Latin America region
  • Negotiation of investment rates, borrowing spreads, financial contracts, and cash management fees with banking partners
  • Supervision and execution of subsidiaries’ NDF and foreign exchange transactions via Bloomberg (Spot/Hedging)
  • Supervision of international payments for Brazilian subsidiary
  • Analyze FX gains/losses and FX hedge efficiencies across LATAM region
  • Economic/political analysis and reporting of Latin America political, and macroeconomic drivers impacting Treasury and overall business of the company
  • Monitor and manage trade credit limits of customers and seek open risk hedging solutions for customers lacking credit limits across LATAM region
  • Closely work with subsidiaries and financial institutions across LATAM region in implementing consumer installment payment solutions, offering innovative payment solutions to Company’s final consumers

Requirements

  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, Economics Science, Engineering, or Mathematics.
  • Experience: Experience in treasury related field or prior banking experience.
  • System: Prior experience with Bloomberg and SAP are strong plus.
  • Hard Skills: Advanced Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint skills.
  • Language Skills: Advanced English is a must. Spanish is a strong plus.

title: Supervisor de Produção
description:
RESUMO DO CARGO

Em modalidade de turno: Responsável pela gestão e atividades relacionadas ao processo produtivo na planta em que atua, supervisionando todas as etapas, provendo recursos e monitorando as necessidades de manutenções, sejam preventivas ou corretivas, atendendo os requisitos de qualidade e concentrando o time em temas e rotinas de segurança. Suportar e prover recursos para a equipe de forma a garantir a eficiência da operação e o atingimento dos resultados operacionais, bem como difundir rotinas de gestão da área cascateadas ao nível de turno como Manutenção Autônoma, requisitos do AMPS (Ardagh Metal Production System) e demais requisitos e acordos repassados pela gerência imediata ou corporação.

Em modalidade administrativa: Responsável pela gestão e atividades da área produtiva, supervisionando processos, rotinas e cumprimentos de padrões, servindo de ponto focal e de apoio ao gerente de produção na propagação de conhecimentos, recursos, desenvolvimentos e monitoramentos necessários para execução das rotinas da área. Suporta também o Gerente de Produção em rotinas administrativas da área como reuniões de planejamentos, demandas corporativas, estratégias de melhoria de resultados e sistema de gestão (AMPS).

RESPONSABILIDADES

Em modalidade de turno:

  • Conhecer, proceder e assegurar que as Políticas da Empresa, no que diz respeito a preservação do meio ambiente, prevenção na gestão de riscos e normas de saúde e segurança do trabalho; qualidade do produto; segurança de alimentos (FSSC 22.000); código de ética; compliance; recursos humanos; missão, visão e valores da empresa, buscando o alinhamento da conduta à estratégia/objetivos estabelecidos da Empresa e garantir que sejam cumpridos pela equipe.
  • Atuar conforme os procedimentos vigentes relacionados a gestão de mudança sendo responsável pelo reporte, divulgação, plano de ação e comunicação junto a equipe.
  • Supervisionar e prover recursos para a execução das rotinas da operação, por meio do monitoramento das manutenções preventivas e corretivas dos equipamentos, controle do volume de produção e tipo de rótulo a ser produzido.
  • Realizar a abertura e fechamento das Ordens de Produção, de Manutenção e consumos de materiais necessários para organização das rotinas produtivas.
  • Tomar decisões relacionadas ao processo produtivo, baseadas em análise de dados técnicos e estatísticos para garantir a assertividade da decisão.
  • Direcionar as ações para minimizar as perdas no processo produtivo, aumentar a eficiência operacional e controlar o consumo de insumos.
  • Garantir a execução dos planos de ação e diretrizes da área na busca do atingimento das metas e resultados operacionais.
  • Supervisionar as atividades de retrabalho de produtos fora de especificação de modo adequá-los ao padrão de qualidade, bem como em processos de repacking.
  • Facilitar a comunicação e disseminação das informações corporativas entre a equipe.
  • Desenvolver tecnicamente a equipe de acordo com a matriz de competência avaliando as necessidades individuais de treinamento e atendendo aos prazos definidos pela corporação.
  • Realizar a avaliação de desempenho da equipe, dentro dos prazos estabelecidos, mapeamento as forças e oportunidades de cada colaborador para elaboração do plano de desenvolvimento individual e retenção de talentos.
  • Realizar feedbacks, promovendo o desenvolvimento de cada colaborador em alinhamento às estratégias e valores da empresa.
  • Executar atividades técnicas e administrativas ligadas a gestão de pessoas, tais como: recrutamento e seleção, integração de novos colaboradores, plano e controle de execução dos treinamentos, ajuste do ponto eletrônico, planejamento de férias, medidas disciplinares e desligamento.
  • Promover um ambiente de trabalho saudável para o engajamento da equipe e melhores resultados.
  • Praticar o conceito de “Melhoria Contínua” no processo, implementando melhorias de segurança e qualidade, cumprindo e fazendo cumprir as práticas de housekeeping.
  • Atuar no AMPS (Ardagh Metal Production System) liderando equipes e grupos internos em todas as iniciativas necessárias conformes demandas da gerência imediata ou corporativa.
  • Comunicar a gerência imediata qualquer problema que ocorra no processo produtivo, bem como seguir o fluxo de comunicação definido na planta para envolvimento de outras áreas, quando necessário e aplicável.
  • Comunicar, treinar, acompanhar e tratar quaisquer questões de segurança do time e da área, a fim de preservar integridade física dos colaboradores e aderência do time operacional à cultura e iniciativas na área de EHS.
  • Disponibilizar e gerenciar recursos como gestões visuais, ferramentas e outros juntamente com o time operacional afim de garantir que se mantenha disponibilizado e em bom estado de conservação todos os recursos disponibilizados para correta execução das atividades.
  • Analisar e montar plano estratégico em caso de desvios de resultados de produção, qualidade, segurança e manutenção, apresentando em reuniões solicitadas e acompanhando o ciclo para garantir correto cumprimento de ações estabelecidadas, por si ou por outros.

Em modalidade administrativa, além de saber realizar e monitorar os mencionados acima para turno, deve:

  • Monitorar o plano de produção, a fim de conciliar as demandas corporativas para atendimento ao cliente com as necessidades locais da planta, montando estratégias de atendimento por módulo e por tipos de produto.
  • Realizar gestões de rotinas, criando e acompanhando indicadores a fim de suportar a execução das rotinas operacionais pelos times operacionais de turno de maneira correta, conforme padrões estabelecidos para cada atividade.
  • Suportar o gerente de produção, por sua solicitação ou ausência, em rotinas administrativas como reuniões corporativas e locais, demandas pontuais ou rotineiras, seja nos temas de segurança, qualidade, produção, manutenção, rh, bem como qualquer outro tema definido que alinhe a área aos requisitos definidos pela organização.
  • Realizar a gestão de KPIs da área já definidos pela companhia visando atingimento de metas e resultados.
  • Ser um facilitador de informações e conhecimento na área, treinando ou suportando os supervisores de turno envolvendo a todos nos temas necessários para a área produtiva.
  • Realizar trabalhos/análises estratégicas para a área, de forma mais abrangente e sistêmica comparando ao supervisor de turno, visando melhoria de resultados e atendimento ao cliente.
  • Auxiliar o Gerente de Produção na condução da Manutenção Autônoma na área produtiva.
  • Participar da implementação de Trials da área, quando solicitado, e repassar informações e direcionamentos aos turnos.
  • Liderar projetos na área produtiva, sejam esses definidos pela gerência local ou corporativa. Ex.: Plant of the Future (PoF).
  • Garantir que as rotinas de reuniões da área produtiva ocorram com o envolvimento correto das pessoas necessárias para boa condução e atingimento dos objetivos.

Formação

Superior completo

Requisitos Técnicos Obrigatórios

  • Pacote Office;
  • Liderança de Equipes (com experiência prévia);
  • Análise e Interpretação de Dados;
  • Conhecimento em indicadores de performance (Produção e Manutenção);
  • Conhecimento e habilidade com processos produtivos;
  • Conhecimento em auditorias e processos de certificações;
  • Habilidade de interpretação e consulta dos manuais técnicos dos equipamentos.
  • Sistemas ERP: SAP;
  • Lean Manufacturing / TPM / WCM ou correlatos;
  • Conhecimento em processos de Estampagem / Corte e repuxo (Prensas);
  • Idioma: Inglês Intermediário ou Avançado.

Sobre a Ardagh:

A Ardagh Metal Packaging (AMP) é uma das líderes globais na produção e venda de embalagens de alumínio para bebidas, com 3 unidades de produção no Brasil - fábricas de latas em Jacareí (SP) e Alagoinhas (BA) e uma fábrica de tampas de Manaus (AM) – e um escritório localizado em São Paulo. Globalmente, a AMP opera 24 instalações de produção nas Américas e Europa, empregando cerca de 5.800 funcionários e registrou receitas de US $ 4 bilhões em 2021. A inclusão, confiança, trabalho em equipe e excelência são nossos valores e junto com o talento que buscamos, serão a fórmula perfeita para crescermos juntos!

Somos apaixonados por sustentabilidade e temos uma ótima reputação pela inovação e qualidade que oferecemos a nossos clientes. Nós somos pioneiros em novos métodos de produção, novas técnicas de design e novas formas de reciclar e economizar energia. Nosso objetivo é reduzir os impactos ambientais, enquanto permanecemos economicamente sustentáveis e socialmente responsáveis.

Na Ardagh, temos a consciência da singularidade de cada ser humano. Valorizamos e respeitamos a diversidade da nossa rede de colaboradores. Aqui, você pode ser você, contribuindo com suas experiências para o nosso negócio. Afinal, cada um é um mundo, e, na Ardagh, todo mundo importa! Gostou? #VEM ser você :)

Se seu perfil corresponde à vaga, candidate-se a essa posição e #VEMserLateiroAMP.
