title: Monitoring Specialist
description:
About Playtech

Founded in 1999, the company has a premium listing on the Main Market of the London Stock Exchange and is focused on regulated and regulating markets across its B2B business. By leveraging its proprietary technology, Playtech delivers innovative products and services to ensure a safe, engaging and entertaining gaming experience.

As the gaming industry's leading technology company, it combines business intelligence-driven software, services, content, and platform technology to drive excellence and innovation across the sector. Read more about who we are and what we do here: and
Here at Playtech, we genuinely believe that people are our biggest asset. Diverse thoughts, experiences, and individual characteristics enrich our work environment and lead to better business decisions. Embracing differences and maintaining transparency in our processes is the core of Playtech's overall commitment to responsible business practices.

Ready to level up your career?

Playtech Managed Services Sao Paulo is looking for a proactive Monitoring Specialist with excellent communication, attention to detail, reaction time and problem-solving skills. Job Description

Your influential mission. You will...

  • Perform Monitoring, Incident Management, Redundancy and Incident Reporting activities.
  • Work on shifts (16/7 coverage ).
  • Monitor multiple business systems and detect incidents across multiple service dependencies.
  • React by executing appropriate redundancy protocols based on service type.
  • Coordinate incident communication with multiple parties.
  • Familiarize yourself with Incident Management documentation.
  • Learn the company products at a technical and operational level, including backend settings, integrations and monitoring dashboards.
  • Liase with third parties during Incident Management.
  • Understand how the environments and available configurations work.
  • Acquire insight into Incident Management processes in a global company.
  • Communicate daily with other teams in and outside the company.
  • Constantly develop skills and get new knowledge in the Incident Management domain.
  • Carry out investigations to determine Incident root causes.
Qualifications

Components for success. You...

  • Are willing to develop your career in Incident Management.
  • You have previous experience in Monitoring, Incident Management or a similar role (1 year minimum, 2 or more years recommended).
  • Possess knowledge of Monitoring and Incident Reporting methodologies and processes.
  • Have strong command of English for both written and spoken communication, ensuring clear and professional interaction with internal teams, clients, and external stakeholders.

You'll get extra points for...

  • Having experience working with Grafana or similar tools
Additional Information

Thrive in a culture that values...

  • A supportive and collaborative team environment.
  • Opportunities for professional growth and development.
  • A commitment to innovation and excellence.
  • A diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone is welcome.
  • Comprehensive benefits and competitive compensation.

HOW TO APPLY?

In addition to your CV, please add a brief motivation letter covering your goals, your current experience in Monitoring or related fields, and/or working in a corporate environment. You can write it in the comment section at the end of the application page (under "your message to the hiring manager").

Kindly provide your resume in English.

MONITORING TEAM

The Monitoring Team is a crucial part of the Incident Report Operational Center (IROC). The team is dedicated to centralizing incident monitoring, detection, and initial response across all relevant systems. Our mission is to ensure business continuity and protect customer experience by proactively managing incidents. The team monitors all business systems, detects incidents across multiple service dependencies, and reacts by executing appropriate redundancy protocols based on service type. We manage incident communication and documentation across all service types and criticality levels.

Our team operates 16/7, ensuring immediate response and detailed incident reporting, documenting all actions and outcomes for transparency, accountability, and continuous improvement in incident management.

Join the team at our new Brazilian Playtech Managed Services (PTMS) office, where we work together to support and enhance our live products and services. Be part of a global, dynamic and innovative team that values collaboration, continuous learning, and excellence.

Playtech is an equal opportunities employer. Our mission is to welcome everyone and create inclusive teams. We celebrate differences and encourage everyone to join us and be themselves at work.

title: API Engineer
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for API Designer/Engineer who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will: (responsibilities)

Overview

The API Designer/Engineer is a pivotal role responsible for implementing API Design First principles to create scalable, secure, and consumer-centric APIs. The candidate will focus on designing API specifications and frameworks that ensure seamless developer experiences while meeting Customer's API standards and architectural guidelines.

Key Responsibilities

API Design & Development

  • Adopt an API Design First Approach : Leverage OpenAPI (Swagger), RAML, or AsyncAPI specifications to define APIs before implementation, ensuring clarity and alignment across stakeholders.
  • API Specification Creation : Design API specifications that adhere to Customer's API standards, covering endpoints, data structures, error handling, and response codes.
  • Policy Design and Configuration : Define and configure API policies (security, routing, transformation, throttling, etc.) using tools such as Azure API Management (APIM).
  • Mock API Development : Create mock APIs for early-stage validation and testing to facilitate integration and feedback before development.
  • API Testing : Perform unit testing of API specifications to ensure functionality, reliability, and adherence to defined standards.
  • Environment Configuration : Configure API backend settings within APIM (naming conventions, App Insights, Key Vault) in DEV, UAT, and PRD environments.
  • API Deployment : Deploy draft APIs into the Azure APIM Dev instance and promote them across DEV, UAT, and PRD environments using the API DevOps framework.
  • Documentation : Create comprehensive API documentation, including references, developer guides, and examples, in line with Customer's standards.
  • Metadata Publishing : Publish API Identity Cards (metadata, usage information) to the Azure API Management Developer Portal to enable easy discovery and adoption by consumers.

API Consumer Onboarding

  • Secure Authentication Setup : Configure OAuth/OpenID Connect to ensure secure authentication and authorization for API consumers.
  • Subscription Key Management : Share API subscription keys securely with consumers and maintain robust tracking mechanisms.
  • Integration Testing Support : Collaborate with API consumers during integration testing to resolve issues and provide guidance on proper usage.

Testing & Validation

  • Functional Testing : Conduct and support API functional, integration, and performance testing to validate API readiness and scalability.
  • Mock and Staging Environment Management : Ensure availability of mock services and staging environments for API testing and feedback gathering.

Skills and Expertise

  • API Design First Expertise : Proficient in designing APIs using OpenAPI, SwaggerHub, or similar tools with a focus on consumer-first design principles.
  • Azure API Management : Deep experience in configuring and managing APIs using Azure API Management.
  • Security Standards : Strong knowledge of OAuth2, OpenID Connect, and API key management best practices.
  • Documentation Excellence : Skilled in creating developer-friendly documentation and API identity cards.
  • Testing Proficiency : Familiarity with API testing frameworks and methodologies to validate functionality and performance. Proficient in using Postman tool

What can you expect from us?

• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.

What do we offer?

At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!

title: Data Management Analyst
description:
About InComm

InComm is a global leader in the payments industry with over 30 years of experience and a presence in 30+ countries. As pioneers in gift cards, we hold two-thirds of the global market share.

Our mission is to revolutionize global commerce through innovative payment technologies for retailers, brands, and consumers.

Job Summary

We are looking for Data Management Coordinator professionals to join our team. This role is fully remote in Brazil (CLT) and offers an opportunity to work in a dynamic environment supporting critical data processes.

We are seeking Data Management Coordinator professionals to join our team in fully remote positions based in Brazil (CLT). This role supports critical data processes and requires strong attention to detail, accuracy, and collaboration across multiple teams.

While all coordinators will work within MDM processes, there are two distinct specializations :

  • Credit & Contract Administration – Responsible for managing the contract lifecycle, reviewing documentation for accuracy, performing credit checks, and ensuring proper data entry across multiple platforms.
  • Location & Administrative Maintenance – Focused on maintaining location data integrity, including new setups, updates, closures, and supporting special projects related to merchant and location administration.

Both specializations play a key role in supporting operational excellence and require the ability to meet deadlines while delivering high-quality results.

Responsibilities

  • Process assignments within standard timelines (2 business days)
  • Ensure accuracy and completeness of data in MDM systems
  • Collaborate with Sales, Account Management, and Finance teams
  • Track and report data metrics for compliance and performance

Credit & Contract Administration:

  • Review incoming contract documentation for discrepancies
  • Perform credit checks in accordance with company policy
  • Enter approved contracts into multiple systems
  • Maintain merchant documentation and follow up on pending agreements

Location & Administrative Maintenance:

  • Set up new locations and update existing records in MDM
  • Manage location name changes, moves, closures, and inactivations
  • Support special projects assigned by the Data Administration Team

Requirements

  • College degree preferred (not required)
  • Professional English communication skills
  • Strong Excel skills (VLOOKUP and report comparison functions) for MDM profile
  • Administrative experience and ORACLE knowledge for contract profile
  • Ability to learn quickly and work well in a team
  • Credit review experience is a plus

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Detail-oriented with strong organizational skills
  • Ability to manage repetitive tasks efficiently
  • Comfortable working in fast-paced environments

title: Senior Murex Integration Specialist (S4C)
description:

Luxoft has one of the world's leading Murex practices. We are a top-tier Murex Alliance Partner and a market leader in implementation, integration, upgrade and migration. We provide end-to end project services and have delivered over 200 successful Murex projects across all major asset-classes and sectors including investment banking, asset management, corporate treasury and insurance.

Whether you possess a background in finance, technology or Mathematics, your experience in the capital markets industry would be of high interest to us.

(At least 3 years)

- Build new up / down stream integration(s)

- Convert existing integration point with Murex version change

- Development of MxML (Workflows, Exchange)

- XSL / Transformation

- Scripting (bsh, ksh, ...etc.)

- Perform various levels of testing for assigned deliverables as well as participate in formal release cycles (SIT/UAT)

1. Provide professional services to Murex clients:

o Provide services in the domain of system integration, business intelligence and data flows through the full lifecycle of the MX.3: requirements analysis, configuration build, installation, training, upgrade, and production support.

o Professionally interact with Murex colleagues and clients.

2. Build, test, and provide support to clients on MX.3 integration modules.

o Contribute to project implementations

 Participate in design, build, and test phases sometimes remotely and other times at the client site as needed.

 Develop trade workflows and interfaces to set up communication between external platforms and murex to receive trade and other data feeds, process them, save into the system, and send acknowledgement. Use a combination of MXMLExchange, MXopenconnect, Murex APIs, and Datamart to successfully deliver such solutions.

 Contribute to functional documentation of the test cases and use cases by the client.

 Contribute to Design documentation for the Build process of the Product.

 Develop and maintain end-to-end configuration management packages etc. Install, Deploy and test Murex packaged interfaces like MDIT (market data interface tool), Markitwire, BSMT and MarkitCredit to receive live and end-of-day data from external providers like Bloomberg, Reuters, Markit, etc.

o Handle support cases from notification to resolution and validation.

• Participate in the business as usual and project support: follow-up of client open cases through email, CRM portal, phone-calls and on-site visits

• Develop an understanding of ongoing activities and manage own deliverables / progress

• Manage bug fixes and enhancements with the Product Team

3. Integrate with various teams to deliver the right solution to client.

o Work with S4C stream leads, Front-Office, Back-Office, or Risk teams to understand requirements and develop solutions for the client.

o Work with the Product division team to provide them timely details on defects - how to reproduce the issue, project/client constraints, and how to validate the fix.

o Follow up with the S4C stream leads, the Project Manager, and other teams to meet deadlines and regular meetings to make sure the delivery is on time.

4. Work with technologies including SQL, Unix, and Murex proprietary standards like Murex Scripting Language (MSL), XMLF, etc. for client solutions.

o Use SQL for end-of-day report generation, STP (straight through processing) failure issues, P&L evaluation, for analyzing issues in trade feed and status Etc.

o Java programming skills are not essential but are a plus.

o Various Murex proprietary languages and formats: Data Query Language for querying in various screens in MX.3, MSL (Murex Scripting Language) for pre-trade logic, XMLF for post-trade flow processing, MxML in various contexts, etc.

o Create shell/python scripts for automation of day-to-day manual activities.

Understand requirements, analyze the problem areas of the current system and behavior of pre- trade and post-trade workflow, and integration points.

Must:

- 4+ years experience with Murex Datamart and workflows

- Must know any 2 of the following technologies: MxMLExchange, RTBS/MDCS, Datamart, C2.0 Product interfaces

- SQL; XML; MxML; UNIX; Scripting languages

- Hands on experience with Murex MxML Exchange development

- Strong Knowledge of SQL/RDBMS technology

- Be detailed-oriented, a quick learner and self-starter

- Possess good verbal and written communication skills

- Must have strong organization skills

- Previous Experience in Murex Integration (MxML/WF) experience

- Strong Knowledge of SQL/RDBMS technology

- Familiarity with UNIX/Linux operating systems

- Rigorous attention to detail

title: LATAM LABORATORY MANAGER
description:
Gene Solutions: Transforming Global Healthcare through Precision Medicine

Gene Solutions is a pioneering biotechnology company redefining the future of genetic testing and precision medicine. Headquartered in Singapore, the company has rapidly expanded beyond APAC into the United States and is now entering new markets across Latin America, Europe, and the Middle East.

By integrating Next-Generation Sequencing (NGS) and Artificial Intelligence (AI), Gene Solutions offers a comprehensive portfolio of advanced genetic solutions that empower reproductive health, enable multi-cancer early detection, and support precision oncology.

Our Mission

As Gene Solutions expands globally, our mission remains clear: Bring World-class Genomics Closer to All.

We are committed to making genetic testing more accessible, affordable, and clinically impactful-empowering physicians and patients worldwide through innovation, collaboration, and cutting-edge science.

If you're passionate about advancing healthcare, driving innovation, and making a meaningful impact through medical AI, we invite you to join us in shaping the future of medicine.

Position Overview

We are seeking for a dynamic and results-oriented Laboratory Manager to collaborate with the expansion and growth of our business, with a primary focus on Brazil, LATAM market. This role will report to LATAM Director and is based in São Paulo.

JOB DESCRIPTION

  • Oversee the daily operations of the laboratory, ensuring efficient workflow and timely delivery of results
  • Implement and monitor quality control measures to ensure accurate test results and adherence to regulatory guidelines
  • Stay abreast of technological advancements and industry trends, evaluating and recommending new equipment and methodologies for improved laboratory efficiency
  • Design and continuously monitor detailed and complete SOPs for testing procedures
  • Provide direct training and guidance to laboratories in the Latam region
  • Ensure compliance with all applicable regulations, standards, and guidelines
  • Develop and update E-learning materials related to testing procedures
  • Prepare plans for establishing satellite laboratories and partner laboratories
  • Monitor and maintain the quality of testing at partner laboratories
  • Collaborate with other stakeholders to provide prompt and accurate laboratory results.
  • Coordinate with other departments, such as R&D, Medical, Data team to ensure seamless integration and information exchange.
  • Collaborate with bioinformatics and data analysis teams to ensure accurate and timely data analysis and interpretation.
  • Perform other tasks as assigned by the Board of Directors (BODs)

JOB REQUIREMENTS

  • Master's degree or higher in Biology, Biotechnology, Biomedical Science, or other related fields
  • Minimum of five years of experience in laboratory management, preferably in a medical/ NGS/ genetic/molecular testing laboratories
  • Knowledge and experience in operating Next Generation Sequencing (NGS) systems and platforms (e.g., Illumina, Thermo, Element, MGI, etc. ) for NGS or molecular biology labs
  • In-depth understanding of laboratory safety management systems , including preventive measures and best practices
  • Experience in training and developing staff in both technical and soft skills, as well as career orientation
  • Flexible in working outside of standard office hours
  • Willing to travel frequently, both domestically and internationally, as required by the job
  • Strong teamwork , presentation , and persuasion skills
  • Strong communication and problem-solving skills
  • Capable of planning and being proactive at work
  • Good organizational and coordination skills
  • Fluent in English and Spanish

title: Especialista Clínico EB
description:

Nossa missão é clara: trabalhar em parceria com os profissionais de saúde para desenvolver qualidade de vida aos pacientes.

Acreditamos que o impacto real acontece quando:

✅ Colocamos o paciente no centro de tudo o que fazemos

✅ Atuamos como parceiros dos profissionais de saúde

✅ Apostamos fortemente em inovação e ciência

✅ Contamos com equipes engajadas e com mentalidade vencedora

Na Urgo , cultivamos uma cultura de aprendizado, excelência e colaboração, onde cada pessoa pode se desenvolver e deixar sua marca.

Especialista Clínico EB

Realizar visitas às pessoas com Epidermólise Bolhosa no ambiente domiciliar e hospitalar, sendo referência nas regiões de atuação para familiares, profissionais de saúde, associações de pacientes, auxiliando na conscientização e no cuidado das pessoas com EB através das tecnologias da Urgo Medical, com foco na melhora da qualidade de vida em consequência da cicatrização.

Atuação nas Regiões: São Paulo Capital, Grande São Paulo, Vale do Paraíba e Litoral Paulista .

Requisitos:

  • Superior completo com graduação em Enfermagem
  • Pós-Graduação em Estomaterapia e/ou Enfermagem Dermatológica (completo ou cursando)

  • Orientação para resultados: cumprimento das metas de atuação em campo e contribuição direta para os objetivos comerciais.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
TG Lab is a technology company powering some of the biggest winners in sports betting and online casino products. We provide player account management and engagement technology to industry leaders such as Stake.com, Belgium National Lottery, Betsson Group , and many others. Our innovative yet practical solutions fuel world-class real-money wagering technology that supports over 1 million players . Our iGaming software is designed for distribution to casino and sportsbook operators across the EU, USA , and other international markets.

We are looking for data-driven innovators who want to shape the future of iGaming and make a real impact on the industry. We value integrity, a curious mindset, empathy, and a commitment to quality. If you are eager to learn, unafraid of challenges, and ready to grow with a like-minded team — we want to hear from you.

Role

As a DevOps Engineer, you will be responsible for the design, development, testing, and deployment of products that help companies engage with their customers in efficient and personal ways.

Our technology stack is built in Scala, NodeJS, and Ruby on Rails, running on Cassandra, MongoDB, ElasticSearch, and Kafka. We containerize and deploy with Kubernetes on AWS. You will be responsible for service delivery, reliability, scalability, monitoring, and helping define all this as immutable infrastructure-as-code.

Responsibilities

  • Deploy and maintain critical applications on cloud-native microservices architecture.
  • Implement automation, effective monitoring, and infrastructure-as-code.
  • Deploy and maintain CI/CD pipelines across multiple environments.
  • Support and work alongside a cross-functional engineering team on the latest technologies.
  • Iterate on best practices to increase the quality & velocity of deployments.
  • Sustain and improve the process of knowledge sharing throughout the engineering team.

Requirements

  • Experience deploying and maintaining scalable, resilient and highly available systems in cloud environments.
  • Skills in automation of repetitive tasks (scripting via Bash, Python, Ruby).
  • Practical experience with Docker containerization and clustering (Kubernetes, ECS, Rancher).
  • Expertise with AWS (e.g., IAM, EC2, VPC, ELB, ALB, Autoscaling, Lambda).
  • Experience with version control system (e.g., Git, Gitlab).
  • Experience with configuration management tools (e.g., Ansible, Chef).
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code (e.g., Terraform, CloudFormation.
  • Good written and verbal communication skills in English.

Working with us implies

  • Memorable company parties and social activities like team buildings and monthly birthday celebrations.
  • Working in a company with a global culture, experience, and reach.
  • Working on-site in our modern, bright, and comfortable office space located in downtown Foz do Iguaçu, with a great working atmosphere, a collaborative team of amazing people, and open-minded managers.
  • Opportunities to build valuable skills, work with unique and interesting projects for the sports industry, express and implement your ideas and grow your career.

The monthly salary range will depend on the selected candidate's experience and skills. We will contact only shortlisted candidates.

title: Cyber Security Manager (Blockchain & Tokenization)
description:
Security Manager

Location: Americas, Remote

About Us

Pointsville is an end-to-end alternative asset factory, offering solutions that bridge the gap between emerging digital financial technologies and traditional asset classes. We specialize in Alternative Asset Digitalization and Loyalty Innovation, empowering organizations to unlock new value through tokenization, stablecoin infrastructure, and real-world asset integration.

Our globally distributed team of innovators, builders, and thinkers is passionate about the future of finance. Join Pointsville and be part of shaping the future of digital finance!

Overview

We’re looking for a hands-on security leader who can build, manage, and scale Pointsville’s security and compliance programs. This role is ideal for someone capable of designing enterprise-grade security programs, engineering security tools, and embedding best practices into fast-moving development environments.

What You’ll Do

Security Strategy, Leadership & Program Development

  • Build and lead Pointsville’s global security and compliance function from the ground up.
  • Develop and implement the company-wide security strategy, policies, and frameworks aligned with business and regulatory goals.
  • Conduct organization-wide risk assessments, vulnerability scans, and incident response exercises.
  • Drive security awareness and training programs to strengthen company-wide accountability.
  • Collaborate with executive leadership to ensure security goals align with organizational priorities.

Technical Security Engineering

  • Lead the design and development of advanced security testing and monitoring platforms, including distributed fuzzing systems and validation frameworks.
  • Conduct secure architecture reviews and threat modeling for infrastructure, APIs, smart contracts, and cloud-native services.
  • Integrate Secure SDLC practices into CI/CD pipelines — automating vulnerability discovery, testing, and compliance reporting.
  • Perform deep-dive analysis of vulnerabilities, exploits, and mitigations across web, mobile, and blockchain systems.
  • Partner with Engineering and DevOps to ensure secure-by-design implementation in infrastructure-as-code and deployments.

Cloud, Infrastructure & Data Protection

  • Oversee cloud security architecture (AWS preferred), including network segmentation, IAM, and continuous monitoring.
  • Manage VPNs, multi-region access, and secret management tools (Vault, KMS, etc.).
  • Ensure data privacy and protection measures are embedded in all systems and products.
  • Lead investigations, containment, and response in the event of security incidents or data breaches.

Compliance, Risk & Governance

  • Develop and maintain security compliance frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, GDPR, and CCPA.
  • Prepare and manage internal and external audits and certifications.
  • Identify, document, and mitigate enterprise security and compliance risks.
  • Establish a “privacy by design” and “security by default” culture in collaboration with legal and product teams.

Communication & Collaboration

  • Serve as the main point of contact for all internal and external security and compliance matters.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, and Operations to align security controls with business needs.
  • Deliver clear reporting and recommendations to leadership on security posture, incidents, and ongoing improvements.

Qualifications & Experience

  • 7+ years of hands-on experience in security engineering, product security, or infrastructure security roles.
  • Proven track record designing and deploying security tools and frameworks at scale.
  • Deep understanding of cryptography, secure protocols, and key management systems.
  • Expertise in AWS, Docker/Kubernetes, and large-scale distributed systems.
  • Strong knowledge of application security (OWASP, STRIDE, TARA) and vulnerability mitigation.
  • Proficiency in one or more system languages (Java, C, C++, Rust, Go) and one scripting language (Python, Shell).
  • Experience with blockchain and smart contract security preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to automate security controls, conduct penetration testing, and perform design reviews.
  • Strong communication and leadership skills, with experience mentoring engineers and influencing cross-functional teams.
  • Demonstrated proficiency in written and spoken English

We are committed to providing equal opportunity for qualified applicants to contract positions, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status. This is a contract opportunity, not a direct employment role.

description:
Somos PepsiCo

Conheça um pouco mais sobre a PepsiCo: PepsiCoJobs

A oportunidade

Garantir um ambiente de trabalho seguro e saudável para todos os colaboradores da planta de Feira de Santana (locais administrativos, Manufatura, Warehouse e etc.), atendendo a conformidade com todas as regulamentações ambientais e de saúde e segurança relacionadas à unidade, incluindo a implementação de políticas, procedimentos e sistema de gestão interno que visam prevenir acidentes, lesões ocupacionais e impactos ambientais.

Garantir o cumprimento dos objetivos, metas e indicadores definidos pela Pepsico e definir estratégias de atuação para a área e desenvolvimento da equipe.

O seu impacto

- Garantir o cumprimento da Política de Meio Ambiente, Saúde e Segurança (SSMA) estabelecida;

- Liderar a equipe local de EHS;

- Garantir o cumprimento das normas locais, estaduais e federais de segurança, saúde e meio ambiente;

- Desenvolver e implementar programas de saúde, segurança e meio ambiente;

- Liderar a implementação e manutenção do sistema de gestão interno na fábrica;

- Gerenciar riscos e minimizar impactos relacionados às atividades, identificar oportunidades de melhoria e novas tecnologias e compartilhar as melhores práticas;

- Liderar inspeções e acompanhar visitas técnicas, inspeções e auditorias de órgãos públicos;

- Analisar e liderar a gestão de mudanças para instalações, máquinas, equipamentos e projetos da área de Engenharia;

- Especificar, controlar e supervisionar, garantindo a qualidade e a eficiência dos sistemas de proteção coletiva e Equipamentos de Segurança, incluindo equipamentos de proteção individual e equipamentos de proteção contra incêndio;

- Interagir ativamente junto aos Comitês Técnicos, principalmente liderando os programas sistêmicos visando a garantia das execuções;

- Apoiar a equipe de Engenharia durante o planejamento e execução de projetos de segurança, saúde e meio ambiente;

- Governar e gerenciar os indicadores-chave de desempenho (KPIs) de EHS, criar planos para melhoria contínua e conformidade;

- Gerenciar o orçamento e o planejamento estratégico da área (Budget);

- Gestão do AOP (Annual Operating Plan);

- Desenvolver e apresentar os resultados de EHS à liderança e à operação;

- Implementar práticas e tecnologias sustentáveis para minimizar o impacto ambiental da operação da planta;

- Gerenciar o licenciamento da planta;

- Colaborar com outras áreas, como produção, manutenção e qualidade, para garantir a integração efetiva das práticas de EHS em todas as atividades;

- Conduzir campanhas, comunicações e programas de conscientização de EHS;

- Manter contato com agências reguladoras e acompanhar atividades de inspeção e fiscalização.

Quem estamos buscando?

  • Graduação em Engenharia com especialização em Engenharia de Segurança e Meio Ambiente;
  • Experiência sólida como líder em Meio Ambiente, Saúde e Segurança (SSMA);
  • Sólido conhecimento do sistema de gestão de SSMA;
  • Auditor líder em ISO 14001, ISO 45001 e suas aplicabilidades;
  • Sólido conhecimento das regulamentações atuais de SSMA;
  • Fortes habilidades de comunicação verbal e escrita;
  • Capacidade de desenvolvimento de talentos;
  • Habilidade desenvolvida em gerenciar dados e estatísticas de SSMA;
  • Habilidades eficazes de networking em uma região multinacional, multifuncional e com múltiplas unidades de negócios;
  • Idiomas: Inglês (experiente), Espanhol (experiente) desejável.
  • Expertise em plataformas de gestão de Requisitos Legais (ex. Sistema IUS Natura);
  • Auditor líder em sistemas de gestão de EHS;

Se esta é uma oportunidade que te interessa, te encorajamos a se candidatar mesmo que não atenda a 100% dos requisitos.

O que você pode esperar da gente?

Na PepsiCo, queremos recompensar da melhor forma o seu desempenho e trabalho, cuidando sempre do seu bem-estar integral. Por isso, oferecemos:

  • Remuneração competitiva, com componentes fixos e variáveis que permitirão alcançar suas metas financeiras.
  • Um programa de flexibilidade que permitirá equilibrar melhor sua vida pessoal e profissional, adaptando seu horário de trabalho ao seu estilo de vida.

  • Programas que ajudarão a cuidar do seu bem-estar financeiro e a alcançar suas metas em todas as etapas da sua vida: Programa de Bem-Estar Financeiro, Caixa de Poupança, Fundo de Poupança e Previdência Privada.
  • Adoramos celebrar o sucesso, por isso contamos com programas de reconhecimento por tempo de trabalho, comportamentos, liderança, momentos de vida, entre outros.

Na PepsiCo, estamos comprometidos em promover uma equipe de trabalho diversa, criando um espaço colaborativo, equitativo e inclusivo, onde todas as pessoas - independentemente de como nos parecemos, de onde viemos ou a quem amamos - tenham suas vozes ouvidas. title: Data Engineer
description:
Summary:

We are seeking a highly skilled Data Engineer (Azure Databricks) to design, implement, and optimize enterprise-grade data pipelines. In this role, you will leverage Azure Databricks, Azure Data Factory, SQL Server, and Python to enable scalable, governed, and performant data solutions. You will play a key role in modernizing our data platform on the Azure Cloud, ensuring reliability, efficiency, and compliance across the full data lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities:

· Data Pipeline Development: Design, build, and optimize ETL/ELT pipelines using Azure Databricks (PySpark, Delta Lake) and Azure Data Factory (ADF).

· Data Flows & Transformations: Develop pipelines, data flows, and complex transformations with ADF, PySpark, and T-SQL for seamless data extraction, transformation, and loading.

· Data Processing: Develop Databricks Python notebooks for tasks such as joining, filtering, and pre-aggregation.

· Database & Query Optimization: Optimize database performance through SQL query tuning, index optimization, and code improvements to ensure efficient data retrieval and manipulation.

· SSIS & Migration Support: Maintain and enhance SSIS package design and deployment for legacy workloads; contribute to migration and modernization into cloud-native pipelines.

· Collaboration & DevOps: Work with cross-functional teams using Git (Azure Repos) for version control and Azure DevOps pipelines (CI/CD) for deployment.

· Data Governance & Security : Partner with governance teams to integrate Microsoft Purview and Unity Catalog for cataloging, lineage tracking, and role-based security.

· API & External Integration: Implement REST APIs to retrieve analytics data from diverse external data feeds, enhancing accessibility and interoperability.

· Automation: Automate ETL processes and database maintenance tasks using SQL Agent Jobs, ensuring data integrity and operational reliability.

· Advanced SQL Expertise: Craft and optimize complex T-SQL queries to support efficient data processing and analytical workloads.

Required Califications:

· 5+ years of hands-on expertise with Azure Databricks, Python, PySpark, and Delta Lake.

· 5+ years of proven experience with Azure Data Factory for orchestrating and monitoring pipelines.

· Strong SQL Server / T-SQL experience with a focus on query optimization, indexing strategies, and coding best practices.

· Demonstrated experience in SSIS package design, deployment, and performance tuning.

· Hands-on knowledge of Unity Catalog for governance.

· Experience with Git (Azure DevOps Repos) and CI/CD practices in data engineering projects.

Nice to Have:

· Exposure to Change Data Capture (CDC), Change Data Feed (CDF), and Temporal Tables.

· Experience with Microsoft Purview, Power BI, and Azure-native integrations.

· Familiarity with Profisee Master Data Management (MDM).

· Working in Agile/Scrum environments.

Preferred Qualifications:

Microsoft Certified: Azure Data Engineer Associate (DP-203)

Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert or equivalent advanced Azure certification

Databricks Certified Data Engineer Associate or Professional

  • Additional Microsoft SQL Server or Azure certifications demonstrating advanced database and cloud expertise

title: Bolsista Doutor - PizzattoLog - Programação Perfeita | Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial - IEL/PR
description:
A Fundação Araucária, em parceria com o IEL Paraná, oferece às empresas paranaenses um programa inovador que conecta seu negócio a doutores profissionais. O Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial oportunizará expertise técnica, científica e metodológica, essenciais para impulsionar o crescimento, a inovação e aumentar a sustentabilidade da sua empresa, fortalecendo seu posicionamento no cenário competitivo.

O programa oferece bolsas para a inserção de doutores em empresas paranaenses , promovendo o desenvolvimento científico, tecnológico e de inovação. Os bolsistas atuarão diretamente na empresa, contribuindo com conhecimento de ponta e soluções personalizadas para o mercado , ancoradas na ciência e em evidências robustas.

Mais do que uma ponte entre academia e setor produtivo, o programa fomenta a aplicação prática do conhecimento científico , favorecendo a transformação de pesquisas em inovações reais, com alto impacto socioeconômico . A atuação dos doutores promove a cultura da ciência nas organizações, estimula a tomada de decisão baseada em dados e evidências , e potencializa a capacidade de resolver desafios complexos de forma criativa e sustentável .

Sobre a Oportunidade:

A PizzattoLog é referência em transporte rodoviário e está iniciando um projeto estratégico para evoluir a programação logística e fortalecer a eficiência operacional. Buscamos Doutor(a) com perfil analítico e visão aplicada para conhecer o projeto e contribuir em um desafio real do setor, com atuação próxima da operação e foco em melhorias estruturantes. Se você quer gerar impacto direto no dia a dia da empresa e transformar conhecimento científico em solução prática, venha conhecer essa oportunidade com a PizzattoLog.

Formação Acadêmica:

Doutor em Logística, Engenharia de Produção, Engenharia de Transportes, Administração ou áreas afins

Defesa da tese há, no máximo, 5 anos.

Projeto: Programação perfeita: atrelar carga ideal à disponibilidade de veículo em tempo real

Principais Atividades:

  • Mapear o fluxo atual de programação logística, identificando falhas e lacunas.
  • Realizar revisão bibliográfica e análise comparativa com modelos logísticos de referência.
  • Conduzir pesquisa aplicada com dados reais da empresa.
  • Construir, testar e ajustar um modelo de decisão logística baseado em critérios técnicos.
  • Implantar o modelo junto à equipe operacional e acompanhar os indicadores de desempenho.
  • Registrar os resultados e produzir documentação técnica e científica.

Conhecimento necessário:

  • Análise de processos logísticos;
  • Modelagem decisória;
  • Pesquisa aplicada;
  • Conhecimento em Gestão de projetos;
  • Power BI;
  • Projetos com foco em IA;
  • Excel;
  • Análise estatística;
  • Lean Logistics;
  • Revisão bibliográfica;
  • BPMN;

Valor da bolsa (mensal) : Bolsista (Doutor) R$ 5.000 – Programa Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial

Idioma: Inglês

Formato de trabalho : Presencial

Disponibilidade para viagens.

Local: Curitiba/PR

Soft Skills: Autogestão; Pensamento crítico; Criatividade; Organização.

title: Especialista em IOT
description:

No Brasil, estamos presentes em mais de 4.600, somando mais de 83 milhões de clientes. Liderando no saldo de portabilidade em 2022, com 1,2 milhões de linhas portadas, há mais de 5 anos.

E tem mais: inovamos nossos produtos e serviços para atender cada vez mais e melhor nossos usuários! Por isso, hoje, contamos com soluções de entretenimento (Claro música, Claro tv+, Claro livros, Claro vídeo e Claro gaming), finanças (Claro pay) e muito mais!

Temos presença aeroespacial (com 5 satélites em órbita pela Embratel)e somos referência em conectividade industrial, automotiva, agronegócio e outros.

Também temos um ambiente de conexão entre nossos negócios e startups, que é o nosso hub de inovação, beOn Claro, e desenvolvemos projetos focados na sustentabilidade, como o programa de Energia Limpa, que já contempla mais de 60% das antenas da Claro com energia renovável.

É claro que, para fazer tudo isso acontecer, a gente tem um grande time!

Trabalhamos em um ambiente dinâmico e que unem as nossas Pessoas ao propósito único que é “Conectar para uma vida mais divertida e produtiva”.

E aí, deu match? Vem pra Claro construir o novo com a gente!

Como será o seu dia a dia?

  • Atuação em pré-vendas para apoio aos times de Field e Inside Sales, com foco em soluções avançadas, M2M (rastreamento/monitoramento) Cybersegurança e TI.
  • Participação ativa nas principais negociações dessas soluções, garantindo suporte técnico e comercial, para soluções de Book e Projetos Especiais.
  • Realizar cobrança de oportunidades junto às coordenações, identificando e qualificando demandas em soluções avançadas.
  • Acompanhar o funil de vendas, com foco em crescimento de volume e conversão de oportunidades.
  • Suporte na instalação e pós-venda, garantindo a satisfação dos clientes que fecharam contratos.

O que esperamos de você?

  • Pensa e age a partir das perspectivas dos clientes. Demonstra interesse e curiosidade de conhecer os clientes, seus comportamentos e preferências para atender e superar suas expectativas;
  • Demonstra compromisso permanente em aprender, ensinar e desenvolver, contribuindo para um ambiente descontraído, respeitoso e colaborativo, incentivando a diversidade;
  • É flexível para se desprender de paradigmas e modelos mentais existentes. Busca soluções inovadoras e sustentáveis, para criar vantagens competitivas para o negócio, equilibrando os interesses econômicos, ambientais e sociais.

Pré-requisitos (eliminatórios):

  • Superior Completo em Engenharia Eletrica, Eletronica, Telecom, Rede de Computadores ou Analise de sistemas, Desejável MBA em marketing, Telecomunicações ou afins
  • Experiência comprovada em:
  • Área comercial
  • Pré-vendas e/ou pós-vendas de soluções avançadas e TI
  • Certificações em:

  • M2M (rastreamento / monitoramento)
  • Conhecimento em TI
  • Vivência e conhecimento como IOT
  • Vivência como Consultor pré-vendas

É diferencial:

  • Soluções avançadas e produtos digitais, como:
  • Cybersegurança
  • Voz Avançada (Físico e Virtual)
  • Internet Dedicada
  • MPLS

  • IP Público (TSIP Trunk)
  • 0800 / 0300 / Nun

E por que a escolher a Claro?

Na Claro, pessoas é um dos nossos valores. Com este pensamento, investimos sempre no cuidado com a saúde, bem-estar e qualidade de vida dos nossos colaboradores!

Para que você tenha a melhor experiência em sua jornada com a gente, oferecemos um atraente pacote de benefícios. Veja só:

Na nossa empresa, valorizamos um ambiente inclusivo, diverso, ético, colaborativo e harmônico. Não fazemos distinção de gênero, raça, cor, orientação sexual, posição social ou deficiências. Todos e todas são bem-vindos(as)!

title: Analista de Plataforma Sênior (Kubernets | DevOps)
description:
Analista de Plataforma Sênior (Kubernets | DevOps)

Atuação Presencial em Curitiba / PR

Principais Atividades e Responsabilidades:

Gerenciar, manter e evoluir ambientes Kubernetes on-premise (OpenShift) e cloud (GCP GKE), monitorando performance, consumo e segurança dos clusters.

Conduzir análises de incidentes (RCA), troubleshooting avançado e post-mortems.

Criar, gerenciar e manter pipelines CI/CD, integrações e melhorias de processos, garantindo padrões e melhores práticas de deploy, versionamento, observabilidade e segurança.

Implementar políticas de segurança (RBAC, Pod Security Standards, Network Policies).

Gerenciar componentes como Ingress, Service Mesh, Secrets, ConfigMaps, Storage Classes, External Secrets, Operators, etc.

Aplicar práticas de GitOps com ArgoCD.

Criar e manter scripts de automação com Helm e Terraform para tarefas rotineiras e integrações.

Configurar e monitorar ferramentas de observabilidade como Dynatrace e SolarWinds, garantindo visibilidade ao negócio e resposta rápida a incidentes.

Colaborar com times de desenvolvimento, operação e arquitetura para garantir entregas rápidas, seguras e de alta qualidade.

Criar e manter atualizadas documentações técnicas, diagramas, runbooks e procedimentos operacionais.

Requisitos:

Graduação completa em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia da Computação, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas.

  • Conhecimentos sólidos em ambientes Kubernetes (OpenShift e GKE), com experiência na administração de clusters, deploys, configuração de RBAC, network policies e troubleshooting em produção.
  • Experiência com GitLab, ArgoCD e Jenkins, aplicando CI/CD para pipelines complexos, runners, templates e integração com ambientes on-premise e cloud.
  • Experiência com a solução de observabilidade Dynatrace, configurando métricas, alertas, dashboards e tracing.
  • Conhecimento em Terraform, incluindo desenvolvimento e manutenção de módulos reutilizáveis, gerenciamento de estado remoto e versionamento de infraestrutura.
  • Conhecimento em práticas de segurança em cloud e containers, incluindo hardening de clusters, gestão de segredos, políticas de acesso e scanners de vulnerabilidade.
  • Conhecimento em sistema operacional Linux e virtualização de ambientes com Vmware.
  • Experiência com ambientes de missão crítica e alta disponibilidade.

Desejáveis:

  • Certificações como CKA, CKAD, CKS ou similares.
  • Certificação Google - Professional Cloud DevOps Engineer.
  • Conhecimento e/ou certificação em SRE.
  • Gestão de vulnerabilidades e aplicação de patches.
  • Experiência com serverless, mensageria (Kafka, Pub/Sub, Active AMQ).
  • Conhecimento de linguagens para automação como Python e Bash.
  • Conhecimento em servidores de aplicação Weblogic.

title: Sous Chef Corporativo Pesquisa e Desenvolvimento
description:
A Bold Hospitality Company é a holding responsável pelas marcas Outback, Abbraccio e Aussie no Brasil. Temos 27 anos de experiência e reconhecimento, mas a energia renovada de quem começou sua jornada: no final de 2024, nos tornamos uma empresa nacional, que nasceu da união de dois Sócios - Vinci Compass e Bloomin’ Brands Inc.

O Outback, que é a nossa maior e mais conhecida operação, conta com 187 restaurantes no país. Já o Abbraccio, restaurante com temática italiana, tem 17 restaurantes físicos; e o Aussie, voltado para proteína de frango, conta com dois restaurantes físicos - um no Shopping Eldorado, em SP, e um no New York, na Barra da Tijuca - RJ, além da operação no delivery.

A Bold Hospitality Company carrega sua bússola no nome: a hospitalidade. Para nós, é super importante que as pessoas se sintam bem recebidas, acolhidas e que tenham uma experiência positiva conosco em todos os aspectos.

Quais serão as atividades?

Atuar no desenvolvimento de produtos, equipamentos e melhorias operacionais na área de Pesquisa e Desenvolvimento, criando receitas, testando e apoiando na validação de equipamentos, revisando receitas, testando produtos substitutos e ajudando nas entregas dos projetos da área.

Quais as principais responsabilidades?

  • Apoiar no desenvolvimento de novas receitas e adaptações/revisões de receitas existentes;
  • Manter os sistemas de receitas e etiquetas atualizados;
  • Realizar compras de insumos para o departamento e prestação de contas de ingredientes utilizados;
  • Desenvolver receitas baseadas em briefings, tendências e demandas internas de produtos;
  • Registrar as receitas desenvolvidas por escrito, incluindo pesagem de ingredientes e rendimento;
  • Participar ativamente dos tastings da área, preparando os produtos, realizando os ajustes e apresentando-os no calendário anual de desenvolvimento;
  • Controlar o estoque de produtos da cozinha experimental, garantindo datas de validades vigentes, PVPS e rastreabilidade de insumos e amostras recebidas;
  • Apoiar as atividades relacionadas à análise e aprovação de novos ingredientes, desenvolvendo e avaliando novos produtos, como: estabelecimento de padrões de qualidade e identidade de produtos, testes de vida de prateleira, desenvolvimento de especificações e procedimentos de manipulação dos alimentos, teste de transporte e operacional;
  • Preparar e participar de comitês de Operações, contribuindo para viabilizar produtos e campanhas dentro das cozinhas das marcas;
  • Realizar o fechamento da cozinha experimental, limpando equipamentos, utensílios e louças, garantindo a organização e as validades dos produtos diariamente;
  • Manter os materiais de receitas e etiquetas atualizados: Recipe Viewer, Sysprep, Build Card Digital, etc
  • Desenvolver conteúdos de apoio para operações para facilitar entendimento de receitas, alergênicos e melhores práticas operacionais;
  • Testar equipamentos atuais e novos para as marcas, redigir relatórios sobre os resultados e contribuir na homologação;

O que você precisa para trabalhar aqui?

  • Candidatos com formação superior completa ou técnica em gastronomia ou similares;
  • Conhecimento avançado em Segurança do Alimento;
  • Pacote office intermediário, com bom domínio em Excel e Word;
  • Domínio de outros idiomas será considerado como diferencial.
  • 2 a 5 anos de experiência com foco em cozinha – especificamente em desenvolvimento de cardápio, teste de equipamentos, execução e registro de receitas.

Quais são os nossos benefícios?

Seguro de Vida

Estacionamento ou vale-transporte para sua mobilidade!

title: Subscritor Riscos Agrícola Pl
description:
SOBRE A MAPFRE

Você já pensou em trabalhar em uma das maiores seguradoras do mundo? NOSSOS BENEFÍCIOS

A MAPFRE é feita de pessoas, por isso retribuímos da melhor maneira possível o comprometimento de nossos colaboradores, que contam com:

  • A jornada diária conta com horário flexível, formato de trabalho híbrido;

  • Disponibilização de cursos e treinamentos presenciais e E-learning em nossa plataforma digital, a Universidade Corporativa MAPFRE.
  • A Assessoria do Programa Viva Leve está sempre aberta para ouvir via atendimento 0800 com psicólogos, assistentes sociais, orientações de nutricionistas, fisioterapeutas, além de consultoria Pet e orientações com profissionais da área jurídica.

title: Clinical Research Associate II (Cell Therapy)
description:
Clinical Research Associate II (Cell Therapy)

Greater Sao Paulo Area / Hybrid

Greater Rio de Janeiro Area / Hybrid

Our 3 Core Values

• Intelligence

• Integrity

• Initiative

Our mission is to harness the immune system through innovative cell therapies and other modalities to deliver widely accessible cures. Patients are waiting!

What You'll Do

The Clinical Research Associate (CRA) II will be the primary liaison between the Investigator sites and Nexcella, responsible for overall site conduct and establishing important relationships with key site personnel. The CRA will perform key job functions in accordance with ICH Good Clinical Practice (ICH GCP), FDA regulations, Nexcella SOPs and work practices while supporting the organizational mission to advance the development of promising oncology therapies and technologies to benefit patients. CRAs are expected to work in a hands-on, highly visible and autonomous role. CRAs must have the ability to be flexible and represent Nexcella in a positive and professional manner while collaborating across all levels with the clinical teams and Sponsors/vendors.

Responsibilities :

• Perform site selection, initiation, monitoring, and close-out visits of investigational sites for the Nexcella portfolio of clinical trials.

• Manage the progress of assigned sites by tracking patient recruitment and enrollment, CRF completion and submission, source data verification, data collection, and data query generation and resolution.

• Conduct monitoring activities, including, but not limited to the following:

o Ensuring PI oversight of all trial activities

o Source data review and verification with EDC fields

o Essential documentation review and reconciliation

o Investigational Product (IP) management and accountability

o Lab/kit supply management

• Develop collaborative relationships with investigative sites and personnel.

• Maintain communication with sites through frequent contact to ensure site compliance, adequate enrollment, and understanding of study requirements.

• Write and submit complete and accurate visit letters and reports of investigational site findings and update applicable CTMS.

• Escalates observed deficiencies, issues, and corrective and preventative action plans as appropriate.

• Participate in audit preparations and follow-up, as needed.

• Review and address protocol deviations, data quality issues, and identify process improvements for assigned sites.

• Be a collaborative member of the study team: provide insight, updates, and strategies to improve processes.

• Ability to think critically while prioritizing tasks in an efficient manner to meet study deliverables.

• Contribute to CRF development and perform User Access Testing, as requested.

• Assist with other duties as assigned.

Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree in life science/biomedical/medical science with a proficient knowledge of the clinical/scientific terminology and methods common to the oncology therapeutic setting.

• 2+ years clinical research experience is required.

• 2+ years experience at a CRO or Sponsor required.

• Independent field monitoring experience of oncology clinical trials is required.

• Early phase oncology experience is preferred.

• Proficient knowledge and practical utilization of ICH- GCP and applicable regulatory requirements.

• Strong communication (written and verbal) and interpersonal skills.

• Demonstrate effective presentation skills by clearly explaining complex concepts to a broad range of audiences.

• Ability to independently prioritize tasks with excellent time management skills.

• Highly proficient in computer applications including Microsoft suite of applications, EDC and CTMS applications.

• Fluent in English (written and verbal)

About Nexcella

Nexcella Inc., a wholly-owned Immix Biopharma subsidiary, is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company trailblazing cell therapies in AL Amyloidosis and other serious diseases. Our lead candidate is sterically-optimized BCMA-targeted chimeric antigen receptor T (CAR-T) cell therapy NXC-201.

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.

O que você precisa ter

  • Vivência com NodeJS para integração e suporte às automações.
  • Experiência no consumo e desenvolvimento de APIs REST .

title: Gerente administrativo e financeiro
description:
Summary

We are looking for an experienced Finance Manager to partner with the Managing Director and the market team to deliver the business plan and support operational execution. This is a managerial role focused on leadership, planning and process improvement, with occasional hands-on operational tasks.

Key responsibilities

Financial and operational leadership

• Act as a trusted business partner to the Managing Director and the wider market team to deliver budget and strategy.

• Own the annual budget, periodic reforecasts and the monthly forward-looking risks & opportunities view, and drive commercial action plans where required.

• Break the business plan and budget into measurable building blocks and KPIs, ensure they are tracked by the FP&A team and by functional partners, and lead corrective actions when performance deviates from target.

• Track return on key investments, including capex for new sales initiatives, and provide actionable analysis to improve outcomes.

• Provide occasional hands-on operational support at month-end to ensure accurate and timely close (see operational tasks below).

Hands-on operational support

• Perform or assist with select month-end journal entries and accruals to support timely close.

• Reconcile key balance sheet accounts and resolve reconciling items when needed.

• Support billing or cash collection tasks in peak periods to ensure targets are met.

• Coordinate with shared services or external teams to clear blockers that would delay reporting.

Finance team leadership

• Build and develop a high-performing finance function aligned to company strategy.

• Line-manage and mentor key direct reports (for example Financial Control, FP&A, Billing and Cash Collection), ensuring the right people are in the right roles.

• Lead recruitment and onboarding of new finance talent as the business grows to support delivery of the plan.

• Foster collaboration between finance and commercial teams to embed financial discipline across the market.

Process leadership

• Provide market leadership on ERP implementation and realise business benefits from new systems.

• Identify and prioritise process improvements across the business (for example debtor management) and drive execution to close the gaps.

• Work with the Group finance community to implement best practices and share learnings that other markets can adopt.

Reporting and compliance

• Ensure accurate and timely monthly and annual reporting that meets Group and third-party obligations and that tracks progress against business goals and KPIs.

• Plan and oversee the annual audit and tax filings, working with the Group tax and control teams to optimise outcomes.

• Support wider reporting requirements such as CSRD and other regulatory or sustainability disclosures as required.

Liquidity and cash management

• Drive delivery against cash targets, ensuring profit is converted into cash.

• Assign ownership and targets for each element of working capital, and drive process improvements where necessary.

• Maintain a 13-week cash flow forecast and a budgeted liquidity plan.

• Coordinate with Group to repatriate cash to the parent company in line with the plan.

Project leadership

• Lead ad-hoc strategic projects, including business cases for commercial opportunities and support for acquisitions or integrations as they arise.

• Provide commercial and financial analysis to support decision making and monitor project outcomes.

Desired experience and skills

• Proven finance manager experience in a commercial environment, ideally with exposure to FP&A, financial control and cash management.

• Strong analytical skills and experience converting financial insight into commercial action.

• Experience leading finance teams and developing talent.

• Comfortable working with ERP systems and driving process improvements.

• Hands-on month-end close experience and a pragmatic approach to resolving operational issues.

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

title: Operations Manager
description:
Head of Operations (Physical Expansion & Product Lineup)

São Paulo (base) | Frequent travel across Brazil

PJ | Full-time

About Pagô

Pagô is evolving.

We are moving beyond a purely digital model to build a field-driven financial operation , with physical points of presence embedded in the real Brazilian economy.

These locations will not only operate Pagô’s core products — they will also serve as distribution hubs for a broader financial product lineup , built in partnership with external providers.

This role exists because physical execution, product mix, and partnerships must be built together .

The Role

We are looking for a COO with a CEO mindset to design, build, and run Pagô’s physical operations , end to end.

This includes:

  • Building the physical operation
  • Defining what products are offered in each location
  • Structuring and managing relationships with financial product providers

You will take Pagô from strategy to the ground — location by location.

This is a builder role , not a maintenance role.

What You Will Build

  • Pagô’s physical operational model
  • A scalable store-level product lineup (payments, credit, and partner products)
  • Strategic relationships with financial product providers
  • On-the-ground presence in selected cities (especially in the Brazilian interior)
  • Teams, routines, and processes that function in real environments
  • A repeatable playbook for physical expansion

Responsibilities

  • Design and implement Pagô’s physical operations strategy
  • Identify, evaluate, and support the selection of new operational locations
  • Lead the setup of physical points of presence (from zero to running)
  • Define the product lineup offered in each physical location , aligned with local demand
  • Build and manage relationships with financial product providers and partners
  • Negotiate commercial terms, distribution models, and operational flows with providers
  • Ensure products are properly integrated into day-to-day operations
  • Hire, train, and manage local teams
  • Define operational processes that work in the field
  • Be present where the operation happens: customers, partners, local ecosystems
  • Ensure operational consistency while scaling across locations
  • Act as the main execution leader for physical expansion
  • Work closely with product, credit, and risk teams
  • Report directly to the founder with high autonomy

Who We’re Looking For

This role is for top-tier operators with commercial and product judgment .

You are someone who:

  • Thrives in building operations from scratch
  • Understands how product, distribution, and operations connect
  • Is energized by being in the field, not behind a desk
  • Has strong execution discipline and commercial instincts
  • Is highly organized and ownership-driven
  • Is comfortable making decisions with incomplete information
  • Has full flexibility for travel and on-site work
  • Leads by presence and example

Experience with financial products (payments, credit, banking, fintech, or regulated financial operations) and/or building distribution partnerships is a strong plus .

Non-Negotiables

  • High mobility and availability for field work
  • Hands-on leadership style
  • Comfort with ambiguity and responsibility
  • Strong bias toward execution over discussion

What This Is Not

  • Not a corporate COO role
  • Not a strategy-only position
  • Not a remote or desk-only job
  • Not a role for people who avoid operational friction

Compensation

  • Fixed compensation (PJ)
  • Performance-based bonus tied to:
  • Store rollout
  • Product lineup execution
  • Provider partnerships
  • Operational performance
  • Long-term upside aligned with impact

Why This Role Matters

Pagô believes that real financial infrastructure is built on the ground , close to businesses and their ecosystems.

This role sits at the intersection of:

operations × product × distribution .

If you want to build physical operations, define what gets sold, and decide how financial products reach the field , this role was designed for you.

Interested? Send a DM or apply directly.

Rodou, girou, Pagô. ⚡

title: Oracle Cloud Field Service consultant
description:
Job Specification: Oracle Cloud Field Service Consultant

Contract Role – Remote

Overview

We are seeking an experienced Oracle Cloud Field Service (OFS) Consultant to support the design, configuration, optimization, and ongoing enhancement of our field service operations. This is a remote contract role suited for someone with strong hands-on expertise in Oracle Field Service Cloud, with additional experience in Oracle Service Cloud (OSvC) and Oracle CPQ being highly desirable.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the implementation, configuration, and customization of Oracle Field Service Cloud (OFS) to support business workflows, scheduling, routing, and mobile field operations.
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into scalable functional and technical solutions.
  • Configure OFS modules including capacity, activity management, work order orchestration, routing plans, and mobility experiences.
  • Integrate OFS with other Oracle cloud applications, especially Oracle Service Cloud , Oracle CPQ , and external systems via REST/SOAP APIs.
  • Perform solution testing, UAT support, documentation, and knowledge transfer to internal teams.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve system issues, ensuring seamless field operations.
  • Recommend best practices and continuous improvements in field service processes.
  • Support deployment activities, including data migration, configuration promotion, and post-go-live stabilization.
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams including service operations, IT, product management, and vendors.

Required Skills & Experience

  • 3–5+ years of hands-on experience implementing and supporting Oracle Field Service Cloud (OFS) .
  • Strong understanding of OFS architecture, configuration frameworks, APIs, message scenarios, routing, and capacity planning.
  • Experience designing workflows, activity types, and policy configurations in OFS.
  • Ability to write and interpret OFS API integrations, business rules, and extensibility scripts.
  • Proven ability to gather requirements and convert them into actionable configuration.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to troubleshoot complex issues.
  • Experience working in Agile or hybrid project delivery environments.
  • Excellent communication, documentation, and stakeholder-management skills.

Desired Skills (Nice to Have)

  • Experience with Oracle Service Cloud (RightNow/OSvC) configuration, workflows, and integrations.
  • Experience with Oracle CPQ (quoting workflows, commerce rules, integrations).
  • Understanding of broader Oracle CX Cloud architecture and integrations.
  • Experience with mobile workforce or field service applications outside Oracle.
  • Knowledge of cloud integration tools (OIC, Boomi, MuleSoft, etc.).

title: Product Designer
description:
About the Company

Hi, we’re Actabl. We’re providing better solutions for hotel companies as the world around us evolves and changes related to using technology, finding labor, and maximizing profits. Our mission is to empower the people that power hospitality. We give hoteliers actionable insights to know what to do, the tools to do it, and the visibility to know it worked. We bring together powerful hospitality tech solutions to maximize profits for more than 10,000 properties in hospitality markets around the world.

Our Valued Behaviors

  • Start with People: We are in the hospitality business and hospitality starts with people. This impacts both our being and our doing.
  • Being: We are responsible for building relationships, earning trust, and having fun. These things are fundamental to hospitality.
  • Doing: We will succeed if we start with great people working as one team. Empower others, speak the truth with care, and go together.
  • Demand Integrity: Be trustworthy, be ethical, and be consistent whether someone is watching or not. Demand integrity of yourself and others to build the fabric of a high-integrity organization.
  • Delight the Customer: We aim to delight our customers in the same way our customers aim to delight their guests. The question is not if completed a process or hit a metric, the question is whether or not the customer is delighted.
  • Champion Innovation: We compete in the game of change and win through innovation. Think big and then think bigger when it comes to the innovation required to tackle the problems our customers face daily.
  • Make it Happen: We show up prepared, care about the details, and follow through. Don't get distracted. Don't stop at blockers. Don't make excuses. Find a way and drive until it is done.

About Actabl's Product Design Team

We redefine expectations

We treat SaaS with the same passion and craft you’d expect from world-class consumer products. Our mission is to redefine what hospitality teams can expect from their tools by delivering thoughtful, high-quality experiences and pushing the product forward step by step, with real impact.

Bellhop Design System

Our young design system is called Bellhop because it was inspired by the essence of hospitality. It's a scalable and cohesive system made to empower people who power hospitality. Check out .

  • Own end-to-end design across features and flows, from discovery to delivery.

  • Design intuitive, scalable interfaces for enterprise SaaS products with heavy use of dashboards, complex data tables, and operational workflows .
  • Run user interviews, synthesize insights, and convert them into actionable design decisions.
  • Produce high-quality UI/UX deliverables: journeys, wireframes, flows, high-fidelity screens, prototypes, tables, dashboards, etc.
  • Work closely with our design system team to maintain consistency and push our standards forward.
  • Advocate for user experience and influence decision-making across cross-functional teams.
  • Incorporate AI tools, Vibe Coding, and rapid prototyping into your process to increase velocity and quality.
  • Understand our products, personas, their journeys, and JTBD.

You as a Product Designer

Ideal Profile

You are not a “by the books” Product Designer and have at least 3 years of experience, strong design craft, and excellent communication skills. You are comfortable with high-density enterprise SaaS interfaces such as dashboards and data grids, and you work confidently with design systems and cross-functional teams.

  • 3+ years of experience as a Product Designer (UX/UI) in tech or SaaS companies.

title: 2026 Global Management Trainee Program - LATAM
description:
Hunter Douglas is the world’s leading manufacturer of window coverings and a major manufacturer of architectural products. We are a brand that you know and trust. With more than 100 years of innovation, we’ve defined our industry with proprietary products that deliver revolutionary style and functionality and can be found in millions of homes and commercial buildings globally.

We are searching for candidates that are driven, intelligent, creative, and entrepreneurial. By offering challenging and accelerated opportunities for growth, powered by a shared hunger for success, we create a space for your career to thrive. In return for your expertise, we are committed to providing competitive and robust total compensation and benefit packages to ensure you feel valued. Our dream is to become the fastest growing, most loved, window covering company in the world. What’s yours?

Position Overview

The Hunter Douglas Global Management Trainee Program (GMT) is hand-selected and sponsored by the Executive Leadership Team. This 10-month comprehensive Leadership Development program provides you with the tools and experiences to develop you into a future leader of our organization while providing a holistic view of the business. Throughout this program, you will immediately immerse yourself into the company, the culture, and the industry. You will join a class of other Trainees and gain a community of ambitious peers. You will learn from Hunter Douglas leaders and contribute directly to our purpose and our DREAM. You will gain insights from day one and do real work on different projects while delivering actual results.

Before the program commences, Trainees are paired with a Mentor to help acclimate and integrate you to our organization. Throughout the program, you can expect opportunities to connect and collaborate with our Executive Leadership Team, Global Leaders, Business Leaders, previous Trainees and current Trainees from other Zones.

What you'll do

  • Three weeks of onboarding - one week of local onboarding at your designated hub location and zone. 
    • Global Induction at our HQ - providing an introduction to our company's strategy, culture, products, sales channels and problem-solving approaches.
  • Five months of Field Training in which you will rotate through key areas of our value chain including Sales, Supply, Logistics, Product, Customer Service, and will gain hands-on experience by actively participating in daily operations and project work during each rotation.
  • One week of Leadership and Methodology training to foster a unified system-thinking approach and prepare you for your first project.
  • A four-month individual project in which you will be able to deliver tangible and measurable results as an active team member by applying methodology skills and technical knowledge.
  • Capstone presentation of your project to Leadership, followed by feedback and final placement into a full-time role upon program completion - designed to support your continued leadership development and long-term career growth with Hunter Douglas.
  • First Position Placement can be in any of the following areas: Sales, Operations (Supply, Logistics, Procurement), Product, or Functional. 

Below are examples of projects that previous Trainees' have worked on

  • Create a new implementation process for when Hunter Douglas introduces a new product.
  • Implement recommendations to optimize material usage and mitigate scrap rates at our plants.
  • Pricing Analysis for our e-commerce platforms.
  • Develop a communication strategy to enhance our customer installation journey.
  • Monetize our Market Funnel valuation by quantifying our conversion rates.

Qualifications:

  • To qualify, candidates must have an expected graduation date of December 2025
  • Have demonstrated leadership capabilities through various extracurricular activities including job experiences, internships, student clubs and organizations, and volunteer work.
  • Must be fully mobile and willing to be on-site at one of our major locations throughout the program. Be ready to tackle new challenges in diverse environments, including front line roles in the field, manufacturing plants, regional offices, among others. 

Who you are 

  • Hard-working and enjoys a high level of responsibility.

Seu dia a dia será junto aos times de negócios e outros engenheiros para entender, desenhar e implementar fluxos e produtos de dados que visam eleger os melhores dados de identificação e localização das pessoas. Você estará inserido em ambiente de alta volumetria de dados, complexidade de regras de negócios, soluções técnicas de vanguarda como uso de modelos determinísticos e probabilísticos, data mesh, lakehouse e outras tecnologias de ponta.

Estamos buscando uma pessoa para a posição de Engenharia de Dados Sênior , que queira se desenvolver e aprender, compartilhar, colaborar e inovar, entregando valor para todos os nossos clientes.

Nessa função você vai:

  • Realizar ingestão, tratamento, transformação e distribuição de dados
  • Monitorar os pipelines de dados visando garantia de processamento e qualidade de dados
  • Apoiar no direcionamento da plataforma tecnologia frente as necessidades do negócio
  • Atuar junto com negócio para desenvolvimento de soluções que geram impacto para o negócio
  • Realizar testes unitários e integrados
  • Performar code review com seus pares
  • Implementar e suportar esteira de Machine Learning (MLOPS)

No que você precisa mandar bem?

  • Experiência com Cloud pública (AWS), especialmente com serviços como Athena e Sagemaker
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento de pipelines de dados com Python
  • Conhecimento sólido de ferramentas como Apache Spark
  • Vivência com produtos de dados

  • Conhecimento desejável de modelos de Machine Learning e interesse em soluções de IA
